sa: शरैः कनकपुबैश्च शक्तितोमरकम्पनैः। नाराचैर्वत्सदन्तैश्च भुशुण्डीभिश्च सर्वशः॥
en: With arrows furnished with golden wings, with dares, javelins and Kampanas, with Narachas, Vatsadantas, and Bhushundis,

sa: स विद्धो व्यथितश्चैव मुहूर्तं कश्मलायुतः। निषसाद रथोपस्थे ध्वजयष्टिं समाश्रितः॥
en: Thus pierced and pained, the latter became unconscious and he sat down on the terrace of his and supported himself by holding the flagstaff.

sa: ब्राह्मणानां प्रतिष्ठाऽऽसीत् स्रोतसामिव सागरः। क्षत्रं च ब्रह्म चैवेह योऽभ्यतिष्ठत् परंतपः॥ स कथं ब्राह्मणो वृद्धः शस्त्रेण वधमाप्तवान्। अमर्षिणा मर्षितवान् क्लिश्यमानान् सदा मया॥
en: Became the refuge of the Brahmanas as the ocean is that of the rivers, that afflicter of eneinies who led the life both of a Brahmana and a Kshatriya, how could that Brahinana, venerable in years meet his death through weapons. Intolerant in spirit, he was ever humiliated and had to undergo troubles for my sake.

sa: ध्रुवं युधिष्ठिरं संख्ये सानुबन्धं सबान्धवम्। जेष्यामि पुरुषव्याघ्र भवान् सेनापतिर्यदि॥
en: O foremost of men, if you accept our leadership, then I am sure to conquer in battle Yudhishthira with all his friends and followers.

sa: भुञ्जानानां तु सव्येन उत्सङ्गे चापि खादताम्। पालाशमासनं चैव तिन्दुकैर्दन्तधावनम्॥ ये चावर्जयतां लोकाः स्वपतां च तथोषसि।
en: (If I fail in killing Jayadratha) the hellish living obtained by the people eating meal through left hand, put the food on lap while eating, not abandon the seat of Palasha and brush of Tenduki shall be accepted by me.

sa: ननाद बलवन्नादं त्रासयानो महद् बलम्। अन्ये च रथिनः शूरा भीमसेनधनंजयौ॥ विव्यधुनिशितैर्बाणै रुक्मपुखैरजिह्मगैः। तेषां च रथिनां मध्ये कौन्तेयौ भरतर्षभौ॥ क्रीडमानौ रथोदारौ चित्ररूपौ व्यदृश्यताम्। आमिषेप्सू गवां मध्ये सिंहाविव मदोत्कटौ॥
en: And then he roared out his fierce war-cry, striking, terror into the heart of the enemy's host. ther heroic car-warriors pierced Bhimasena and Dhananjaya with straight-going exceedingly sharp arrows, all furnished with golden wings. Those two foremost descendants of the Bharata race, viz., the two sons of Kunti, sporting on their cars amidst those carwarriors, appeared beautiful, and resembled two enraged lions loO king out for flesh amidst a herd of cows.

sa: रुद्राणामिव कापाली वसूनामिव पावकः। कुबेर इव यक्षाणां मरुतामिव वासवः॥ वसिष्ठ इव विप्राणां तेजसामिव भास्करः। पितृणामिव धर्मेन्द्रो यादसामिव चाम्बुराट्। ६॥ नक्षत्राणामिव शशी दितिजानामिवोशनाः। श्रेष्ठः सेनाप्रणेतृणां स नः सेनापतिर्भव॥
en: Like Kapala amongst the Rudras; like Pavaka amongst the Vasus; like Kuvera amongst the Yakshas; like Vasava amongst the Marutas; like Vasistha amongst the Vipras, like Bhaskara (sun) amongst the lustrous bodies, like Yama amongst the Pitris, like Varuna amongst the creatures of the waters; like the moon amongst the stars, like Usanas amongst the sons of Diti, you are the foremost amongst all commanders of armies; therefore be you our leader.

sa: ततः कृतज्ञा बलिनः सुहृदो जितकाशिनः। त्रास्यमाना भयाद् वीरं परिवQस्तवात्मजम्॥
en: Thereupon grateful, mighty and friendly warriors, ever attended with victory though inspired with fears, yet surrounded your heroic son in order to rescue him.

sa: युद्धाभिकामाशूरांश्च पश्य माधव दंशितान्। त्रिगर्तराजं सहितं भ्रातृभिः पश्य केशव।॥
en: Behold also, O Madhava, innumerable heroes all ardently longing for battle. Behold also, O Keshava, the king of the Trigartas supported by his brothers.

sa: प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम्। मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम्॥
en: I am Pralhada among Daityas, and the Kala among those who count. I am lion among the beasts of prey, and Garuda among birds.

sa: सुतसोमो विकर्णं च तदद्भुतविवाभवत्॥ सुशर्माणं नरव्याघ्रश्चेकितानो महारथः। अभ्यद्रवत् सुसंक्रुद्धः पाण्डवार्थे पराक्रमीः॥ सुशर्मा तु महाराज चेकितानं महारथम्। महता शरवर्षेण वारयामास संयुगे॥ चेकितानोऽपि संरब्धः सुशर्माणं महाहवे। प्राच्छादयत् तमिषुभिर्महामेघ इवाचलम्॥
en: Sutasoma also could not make Vikarna waver. It was a wonderful sight. That great carwarrior, that foremost of men, that greatly powerful Chekitan rushed upon Susharma for the sake of the Pandavas. O king of kings, Susharma however cheated the advance of that great car-warrior Chekitana with heavy shower of Chekitana also becoming exceedingly angry showered on Susharma a shower of arrows as a mass of clouds shower rain on a mountain.

sa: मार्जारः किल दुष्टात्मा निश्चेष्टः सर्वकर्मसु। ऊर्ध्वबाहुः स्थितो राजन् गङ्गातीरे कदाचन॥ कृत्वा मनःशुद्धिं प्रत्ययार्थं शरीरिणाम्। करोमि धर्ममित्याह सर्वानेव शरीरिणः॥
en: A cat, wicked-souled and disinclined to action, once on a time went to the banks of the Ganga and stayed there with his arms upraised. He, having set his heart on holy devotion , to inspire confidence in animals, said to all living beings "I shall practice virtue."

sa: स समासाद्य तं नागं बाणो वज्र इवाचलम्। अभ्यगात् सह पुढेन वल्मीकमिव पन्नगः॥
en: Then like the thunder-bolt rending a mountain open, that dart flying towards the elephant penetrated into its body to the very wings, like a snake entering into its hole in an ant-hill.

sa: न मृष्यामि रणे भीष्मं प्रत्युद्यातं शिखण्डिना। कच्चिन्न रथभङ्गोऽस्य धनुर्वाशीर्यतास्यतः॥
en: I am unable to brook the thought of Bhishma overthrown by Shikhandin in battle. Was then his (Bhishma's) car shattered on his bow burst?

sa: सुशर्मन् गच्छ शीघ्रं त्वं बलौघैः परिवारितः। जहि पाण्डुसुतावेतौ धनंजयवृकोदरौ॥
en: Go you, O Susharma, speedily surrounded by a large host of your troops. Slay me these two sons of Pandu, viz., Dhananjaya and Vrikodara.

sa: संजय उवाच समं व्यूढेष्वनीकेषु संनद्धरुचिरध्वजम्। अपारमिव संदृश्य सागरप्रतिमं बलम्॥
en: Sanjaya said When all the troops were thus placed in battle array, the warriors all clad in armours waited with their excellent standards upraised.

sa: शिखण्डी त रणे श्रेष्ठो रक्ष्यमाणः किरीटिना॥ अविध्यद् दशभिर्भीष्मं छिन्नधन्वानमाहवे।
en: In that battle, protected as he was by Dhananjaya, that excellent warrior Shikhandin, with ten shafts pierced Bhishma whose bow had been cut off.

sa: ऐरावतगतं शक्रं सहामरगणैरहम्। अथवा रुद्रमीशानं सर्वभूतगणार्चिता। योधयेयं रणमुखे न मे क्षत्रेऽद्य विस्मयः॥
en: I would engage even with Indra on the back of his elephant Airavata and attended by the complete host of the immortals. I do not care anything for all this Kshatriyas today,

sa: ततोऽहं नाधिगच्छामि तथा बहुविधं तदा। संहारमप्रमेयस्य ततो मां मन्युराविशत्॥
en: Then though thinking in many ways, I could not find out the means for destroying the infinite creation. At this, anger entered into me.

sa: अलं प्रव्रजितेनेह भद्रे शृणु हितं वचः। इतो गच्छस्व भनं ते पितुरेव निवेशनम्॥
en: There is no need for you to roam about in these woods: Listen to wards that are of benefit to you and go hence to your father's place; may you fare well.

sa: ते पाण्डवेयाः संरब्धा महेष्वासेन पीडिताः। वधायाभ्यद्रवन् भीष्मं सुंजयाश्च महारथाः॥
en: Then those Pandava troops and the mighty car-warriors of the Srinjaya clan, thus afflicted by Bhishma, in battle, rushed to slay that fierce bowmen.

sa: ततः शैक्यायसी गुर्वी प्रगृह्य बलवान् गदाम्। भीमसेनस्ततस्तूर्णं पुप्लुवे मनुजर्षभ॥
en: Then that foremost of men, Bhimasena took up a heavy and might mace made of Saikya iron. He then jumped down from his car.

sa: जम्बूखण्डस्तु तत्रैव सुमहान् नन्दनोयमः। आयुर्दश सहस्राणि वर्षाणां तत्र भारत॥
en: Here is also Jambukhanda, O king, which is greatly populated. O descendant of Bharata, the length of human life there is ten thousand years.

sa: तस्मिन् द्यूतमिदं बद्धं मन्यते स सुयोधनः। तस्मात् तस्यैव सेनाग्रं भित्त्वा यास्याभि सैन्धवम्॥
en: King Suyodhana considers this battle as a game depending on the dice identified with Drona himself. Therefore, penetrating through the divisions of Drona himself, I shall reach the king of the Sindhus.

sa: रथिनः पत्तिभिः सार्धं सादिनचापि पत्तिभिः। अन्योन्यं समरे राजन् प्रत्यधावन्नमर्षिताः॥
en: Car-warriors encountered foot-soldiers, and cavalry-soldiers also engaged with the infantry. Thus, O king, excited with wrath, they rushed against one another in that battle.

sa: स कुञ्जरस्थोरथिभिः शुशुभे सर्वतो वृतः॥ पर्वत वनमध्यस्थो ज्वलन्निव हुताशनः।
en: Mounted on his elephant and surrounded on all sides by the car-warriors, he (Bhagadatta) appeared beautiful like fire illumining a mountain surrounded by forests.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच उलूकं न भयं तेऽस्ति ब्रूहि त्वं विगतज्वरः। यन्मतं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य लुब्धस्यादीर्घदर्शिनः॥
en: Yudhishthira said O Uluka, you need have no fear; speak out without any fear of trouble, what opinion is held by the son of Dhritarashtra, actuated by avarice and having little foresight."

sa: तैश्च मुक्ताञ्छरान् भीष्मो युधि सत्यपराक्रमः॥ निवारयामास शरैः समं संनतपर्वभिः।
en: Then Bhishma of prowess unfailing, in battle, with his own shafts of depressed knots simultaneously baffled all these arrows shot by the hostile warriors.

sa: संजय उवाच शरविक्षतगात्रं तु प्रत्यमित्रमवस्थितम्। अभिमन्युः स्मयन् धीमान् दुःशासनमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then the highly intelligent Abhimanyu with his body mangled with arrow-wounds smilingly addressing his antagonist Dushasana stationed before him, spoke these words.

sa: तामापतन्ती सम्प्रेक्ष्य वियत्स्थामशनीमिव। उत्पत्य राक्षसस्तूर्णं जग्राह च ननाद च॥
en: Beholding it course through the air like the thunder bolt itself, the Rakshasa lightly jumped up and caught hold of it uttering fierce warcries.

sa: सम्प्रावेपन्त कुरवो गावः शीतार्दिता इव। विस्मयोच्चोत्तरीयाणि व्याविध्यन् सर्वतो नृपाः॥
en: The Kurus began to shiver like kine afflicted with the chill of winter. Out of amazement the kings then began to waive their garments;

sa: स विद्धो दशभिर्बाणैस्तोत्रैरिव महाद्विपः॥ ततः क्रुद्धो महाराज भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्।
en: Then like a huge elephant pierced with the hook, the mighty Bhimasena, pierced with those ten arrows, was worked up with rage, O monarch,

sa: त्वरमाणः सुसंरब्धो हयांस्तेषां महात्मनाम्। जघान राक्षसः क्रुद्धः सारथींश्च महाबलः॥
en: Then that highly powerful Rakshasas excited to the highest pitch of fury slew the steeds and charioteers of his high-souled foes, with great activity.

sa: तस्मात् पापं न गूहेत गूहमानं विवर्धयेत्। कृत्वा तत् साधुष्वाख्येयं ते तत् प्रशमयन्त्युत॥
en: For these reasons one should never conceal a sin. Concealed, it is sure to increase, Having committed a sin, one should confess it before the good. They would then destroy it forthwith.

sa: त्रीण्येव तु पदान्याहुः पुरुषस्योत्तमं व्रतम्। न दुह्येच्चैव दद्याच्च सत्यं चैव परं वदेत्॥
en: It has been said that there are three roads which form the best vows of a man. One should never injure; one should always tell the truth; and one should make gift.

sa: ब्राह्मणा: कुरुमुख्यस्य ये मुक्ता हयसारिणः। कुर्वन्ति शान्ति कामस्य रणे योऽयं मया हतः॥
en: What benefit is done to this hero, killed by me in battle, by those Brahmanas who were commissioned to attend upon this foremost one of Kuru's race engaged in following the horse?

sa: तस्य धर्मार्थविदुषो दृष्ट्वा तद् विपुलं तपः। आजगाम द्विजश्रेष्ठः कृष्णद्वैपायनस्तदा॥
en: Seeing those severe austerities of the Kshatriya who was well conversant with religion and Profit, Krishna Dvaipayana, that foremost of Brahmanas, went to him.

sa: अथर्षयः सम्प्रहृष्टाः पुनस्ते कृष्णमब्रुवन्। पुनः पुनः दर्शयास्मान् सदैव मधुसूदन॥
en: Filled with joy, those Rishis once more addressed Krishna, saying, O Destroyer of Madhu, do you repeatedly show yourself to us at all times.

sa: ततोऽस्य कर्म पश्यन्ति शुभं वा यदि वाशुभम्। देवताः पञ्चभूतस्था: किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छसि॥
en: Gifted with these elements, the individual soul comes by a body. The deities that preside over those elements, witness all his deeds, good and bad. What else do you wish to hear.

sa: महावराहं तं देवं सर्वलोकपितामहम्। अहं चैव नमस्यामि नित्यमेव जगत्पतिम्॥
en: I, too, vow my head in respect to that Lord of the universe, that Grandfather of all the worlds, that powerful and huge boar.

sa: ब्राह्मण्यं दुर्लभं लोके राज्यं हि सुलभं नरैः॥ ब्राह्मण्यस्य प्रभावाद्धि रथे युक्तौ स्वधुर्यवत्।
en: Sovereignty may be acquired easily. But the dignity of a Brahmana is not attainable. It was through the power of a Brahmana that we were harnessed to a car like wellbroken animals.

sa: नारद उवाच इत्युक्तः स तु देवेशः प्रतिपूज्य गिरेः सुताम्। लोकान् विसर्जयामास सर्वैरनुचरैर्वृतान्॥
en: Narada said Thus addressed, the great god highly spoke of the daughter of the king of mountains and then dismissed all persons who had assembled there, together with all his own attendants.

sa: लभते नाम लोके च पितृभिश्च महीयते। देवलोके गतस्यापि नाम तस्य न नश्यति॥
en: Such a man is applauded and respected in the world of the Departed Manes. Such a man's name does not die even when he goes to live in the world of celestials.

sa: ततः शुभाशुभं कृत्वा लभन्ते सर्वदेहिनः। इहैवोच्चावचान् भोगान् प्राप्नुवन्ति स्वकर्मभिः॥
en: This world where creatures live is called the field of action. Performing acts, good or bad, all embodied creatures attain to the fruits thereof.

sa: सुवर्णमाहरिष्यन्तस्तत्र गच्छन्तु ते नराः। इत्युक्तः स वचस्तेन चक्रे कारन्धमात्मजः॥
en: And the men who go there thus, succeed in getting the gold. Thus instructed, Marutta, the son of Karandhama, did as he was advised.

sa: द्रौपदी चान्वयाच्छ्वधू विषण्णवदना तदा। वनवासाय गच्छन्ती रुदती भद्रया सह॥
en: Then Draupadi, with a cheerless face, accompanied by Subhadra, followed her weeping mother-in-law who was proceeding on from desire of going into the forest.

sa: पूजां तत्र यथान्यायं प्रतिगृह्य धनंजयः। पुनरावृत्य कौन्तेयो दशार्णानगमत् तदा॥
en: Receiving due honours in all those kingdoms Dhananjaya turned his course. Indeed, the son of Kunti then proceeded to the country of the Dasharnas,

sa: एवं सततमुद्युक्तः प्रीतात्मा न चिरादिव। आसादयति तद् ब्रह्म यद् दृष्ट्वा स्यात् प्रधानवित्।।४७
en: One should, becoming always assiduous in this way and pleased with his own self, within a very short time, attain to that Brahman by seeing which one would become conversant with Pradhana.

sa: उषित्वेह निशामेकां सुखं स्वभवने प्रभो। पुनरश्वानुगमनं कर्तासि जयतां वर॥
en: O lord, having lived for one night in your own palace in happiness, you may then follow the horse, O foremost of victorious warriors!

sa: रमस्वैधस्व मोदस्व देहि चैव यजस्व च। न त्वामभिभविष्यन्ति वैद्या न च तपस्विनः॥
en: Do you sport and grow and rejoice and make gifts and celebrated sacrifices. Neither men of knowledge nor those gifted with penances will then be able to get the better of you.

sa: रमस्वैधस्व मोदस्व देहि चैव यजस्व च। न त्वामभिभविष्यन्ति वैद्या न च तपस्विनः॥
en: Do you sport and grow and rejoice and make gifts and celebrated sacrifices. Neither men of knowledge nor those gifted with penances will then be able to get the better of you.

sa: अवश्यमेव वक्तव्यमिति कृत्वा ब्रवीमि वः। एष न्यासो मया दत्तः सर्वेषां वो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: That which should certainly be said is now said by me. I make over to you this Yudhishthira here as a charge. I entrust you, also to the hands of this hero.

sa: न शक्यमस्य ग्रहणं कर्तुं विपुल केनचित्॥ अपि विश्वकृता तात येन सृष्टमिदं जगत्।
en: O Vipula, no one can make him out on account of these numberless disguises that he is capable of assuming. The very Creator of the universe is not equal to that feat.

sa: तव शुश्रूषया चैव गान्धार्याश्च यशस्विनी। भर्तुः सलोकतामेषा गमिष्यति वधूस्तव॥
en: Through serving you and Gandhari, this daughter-in-law of yours, possessed of great fame, will attain to residence with her husband in the other world.

sa: वेदे चास्य विदुर्विप्राः शतरुद्रीयमुत्तमम्। व्यासेनोक्तं च यच्चापि उपस्थानं महात्मनः॥
en: The Brahmanas always recite the excellent ShataRudriya in his honour, thai is in the Vedas as also that which has been composed by Vyasa.

sa: कश्चित्तु संशयो मेऽस्ति तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह। जातेऽस्मिन् संशये राजन् नान्यं पृच्छेम कंचन॥
en: I have a doubt, do you explain it to me, O grandfather. As regards this doubt that has originated in my mind, I shall not ask any other person for its solution.

sa: वनं गन्तुं च विदुरो राज्ञा सह कृतवणः । संजयश्च महामात्रः सूतो गावल्गणिस्तथा॥
en: Vidura had made up his mind for going to the forest with the king. The Suta Sanjaya also, the son of Gavalgani, the chief minister of Dhritarashtra, was of the same heart.

sa: प्रयतः प्रातरुत्थाय यदधीये विशाम्पते। प्राञ्जलिः शतरुद्रीयं तन्मे निगदतः शृणु॥
en: O king, listen to me as I recite to you that Shatarudriya which I repeat, with controlled senses, every morning after rising from bed.

sa: न ह्यतः सदृशं किंचिदिह लोके परत्र च।॥ यत् सर्वेष्विह भूतेषु दया कौरवनन्दन।
en: There is nothing O, delighter of the Kurus, that is equal in point of merit, either in this world or in the next to the practice of mercy to all living creatures.

sa: प्रायच्छत वरं देवः प्रजानां दुःखकारणम्। द्विजेष्वधर्मयुक्तानि स करोति नराधमः॥
en: The great god, it appears, gave that boon to Nahusha for plunging all creatures into grief. That wretched behaves most unrighteously towards the Brahmanas.

sa: आहिते ज्वलनेनाथ गर्भे तेजः समन्विते। गङ्गायामसुरः कश्चिद् भैरवं नादमानदत्॥
en: When the deity of fire cast his seed gifted with great energy into the womb of Ganga, a certain Asura uttered a terrific roar.

sa: नास्याहं न मदीयोऽयं पापं कुर्याद् विमानितः। इति दद्याद् भयादेव इंढ मूढाय पण्डितः॥
en: I am not his, nor is he mine. If disregarded, he may injure me. From such motives of fear even a learned and wise man may make gifts to an ignorant wretch.

sa: दत्तात्रेयस्य पुत्रोऽभून्निमि म तपोधनः। निमेश्चाप्यभवत् पुत्रः श्रीमान्नाम श्रिया वृतः॥
en: Dattatreya got a son named Nimi having asceticism for wealth. Nimi got a son named Shrimat who was gifted with great beauty of person.

sa: गन्धेनापि हि संग्रामे तस्य क्रुद्धस्य शत्रवः। विसंज्ञा हतभूयिष्ठा वेपन्ते च पतन्ति च॥
en: When he stands, filled with anger, on the field of battle, the very scent of his body deprives all foes of consciousness and they who are not killed tremble and fall down.

sa: एवमत्र महाराज दक्षिणां त्रिगुणां कुरु। त्रित्वं व्रजतु ते राजन् ब्राह्मणा ह्यत्र कारणम्॥
en: Do you also, O great king, make the Dakshina of this sacrifice three times of what is enjoined. Let the merit of your sacrifice increase threefold. The Brahimanas competent for the purpose.

sa: नारद उवाच कृत्तिकासु महाभागे पायसेन ससर्पिषा। संतर्घ्य ब्राह्मणान् साधूल्लोकानाप्नोत्यनुत्तमान्॥
en: Narada said By pleasing, O blessed lady, worthy Brahmanas with pudding mixed with ghee, under the constellation Krittika, one acquires regions of great happiness.

sa: वानप्रस्थैर्गृहस्थैश्च यतिभिर्ब्रह्मचारिभिः। विद्यावद्भिः श्रितां गङ्गां पुमान् को नाम नाश्रयेत्॥६९
en: What man is there who wouldnot seek the protection of Ganga whose protection is sought by hermits and householders, by Yatis and Brahmacharins alike?

sa: देवताभ्य: सुमनसो यो ददाति नरः शुचिः। तस्य तुष्यन्ति वै देवास्तुष्टाः पुष्टिं ददत्यपि॥
en: That man who in a state of purity offers flowers to the celestials finds that the celestials become pleased with him, and as the result of such satisfaction confer prosperity upon him.

sa: कृत्वा प्रवर्ये धर्माख्यं यथावद् द्विजसत्तमाः। चक्रुस्ते विधिवद् राजंस्तथेवाभिषवं द्विजाः॥
en: Thosc best of twice-born ones, having first performed the rite called Pravargya otherwise called Dharma, then duly performed the rite of Abhishva, O king.

sa: तत्र तौ कथयन्तौ स्तां कथा नानाविधाश्रयाः। ब्रह्मर्षिदेवदैत्यानां पुराणानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: Seated there they began to talk with each other on various subjects about the great deities and twiceborn Rishis and Daityas of ancient times.

sa: वेदा धर्माश्च नोच्छेदं गच्छेयुः सुरसत्तमाः। विहितं पूर्वमेवात्र मया वै व्येतु वो ज्वरः॥
en: The Vedas and the eternal duties shall not be rooted out, you foremost of celestials, I have ordained what is proper, in this matter. Let the anxiety of your hearts be removed.

sa: भ्रातृणामविभक्तानामुत्थानमपि चेत् सह। न पुत्रभागं विषमं पिता दद्यात् कदाचन॥
en: If brothers wish (during the lifetime of their father) to partition the family property, the father should give equal shares to all his sons.

sa: एवमुक्तः स मुनिभिर्नारदो भगवान् मुनिः। कथयामास देवर्षिः पूर्ववृत्तामिमां कथाम्॥
en: Thus addressed by those ascetics, the celestial Rishi, viz., the divine Narada, then recited the following story whose incidents had ken place sometime before.

sa: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि योगशास्त्रमनुत्तमम्। युञ्जन्तः सिद्धमात्मानं यथा पश्यन्ति योगिनः॥
en: After this I shall describe the science of Yoga than which there is nothing superior, and how Yogins, by concentration, sce the perfect soul.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततो नारायणसुहन्नारदो भगवानृषिः। शङ्करस्योमया साधू संवादं प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: Bhishma said Then Narada, that holy Rishi, that friend of Narayana, recited the following discourse that took place between Shankara and his wife Uma.

sa: तेषां संश्रवणे चापि निषेदुर्विदुरादयः॥ याजकाश्च यथोद्देशं द्विजा ये चानुयायिनः।
en: Within bearing-distance of those three, slept Vidura and others. The Yajaka Brahmanas and other followers of the king laid slept on their respective beds.

sa: स्थानानि देवतानां हि विमानानि पुराणि च। ऋषीणां चाश्रमाश्चैव बभूवुरसुरैर्हताः॥
en: All the regions of the celestials, their beautiful cars, and their palaces, and the asylums of the Rishis, we.e snatched away by the Asuras.

sa: तेषां तदभवद् युद्धं दशाहानि महात्मनाम्। कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च सुमहल्लोमहर्षणम्॥
en: The battle betwcen the Kurus and the Pandavas went on for ten days. It was so dreadful as to make one's hair stand erect.

sa: सोऽयं स्वयम्भुविहितो धर्मः संकल्पितस्त्वया। ऋते स्वयम्भुवः कोऽन्यः श्राद्धेयं विधिमाहरेत्॥
en: This rite that you have conceived, has been ordained by the SelfCreate himself. Who else save the SelfCreate could ordain this ritual in Shraddhas?

sa: तृतीयं चास्य सम्भूतं नेत्रमादित्यसंनिभम्। युगान्तसदृशं दीप्तं येनासौ मथितो गिरिः॥
en: A third eye, resembling another sun, appeared (on it). That eye began to shine like the Yoga. Fire and began to consume that mountain.

sa: क्षणेन तेन निर्दग्धो हिमवानभवन्नगः। सधातुशिखराभोगो दीप्तदग्धलतौषधिः॥
en: In a moment the Himavat mountains were consumed, with their minerals and summits and blazing herbs.

sa: स तं दृष्ट्वा विशुद्धात्मा त्रासादङ्कमुपागतम्। आश्वास्याश्वसिहीत्याह न तेऽस्ति भयमण्डज॥
en: The pure-souled, king beholding the pigeon take refuge in his lap from fear, comforted him, saying, Be comforted, O bird! You have no fear!

sa: ते च द्वादश कौन्तेय राज्ञां वै विषयात्मकाः मन्त्रिप्रधानाश्च गुणाः षष्टिादश च प्रभो॥
en: The twelve (enumerated above), O son of Kunti, form the principal concerns of kings. These twelve, as also the sixty, having Ministers for their foremost, should be looked after by the king.

sa: स्ववित्तं तेन दत्तं तु दत्तात्रेयाय कारणे। विनयं श्रुतमेव च॥
en: Respecting the duties of the Kshatriya order, as also humility and Vedic learning, the king made large gifts of wealth to the Rishi Dattatreya.

sa: नित्येन ब्रह्मचर्येण लिङ्गमस्य यदा स्थितम्। महयत्यस्य लोकश्च प्रिय ह्येतन्महात्मनः॥
en: Because his emblem always observes the of Brahmacharya, all the worlds, therefore, adore it. This act of worship is said to please him highly.

sa: प्रतिगृह्णामि वो धेनुं कैवर्ता मुक्तकिल्बिषाः। दिवं गच्छत वै क्षिप्रं मत्स्यैः सह जलोद्भवैः॥
en: I shall accept the cow that you wish to present me-You fishermen, freed from every sin, go ye to heaven forthwith, with these fishes also that you have caught with your nets.

sa: उत्तिष्ठ मा शुचः पुत्र नैव जिष्णुस्त्वया जितः। अजेयः पुरुषैरेष तथा देवैः सवासवैः॥
en: Rise up, O son! Do not grieve! Jishnu has not been vanquished by you! This hero is incapable of being defeated by men as also by the celestials headed by Vasva himself.

sa: किमब्रवीत् त्वां संग्रामे सुभद्रां मातरं प्रति॥ मां चापि पुण्डरीकाक्ष चपलाक्षः प्रिबो मम।
en: Oh, at the time of his fall, what words did he give utterance to, addressing his mother? O lotus-eyed one, what did that darling of mine, having restless eyes, say to me?

sa: भीष्म उवाच इदमङ्गिरसा प्रोक्तमुपवासफलात्मकम्॥ विधिं यज्ञफलैस्तुल्यं तन्निबोध युधिष्ठिर। यस्तु कल्यं तथा सायं भुजानो नान्तरा पिबेत्॥
en: Bhishma said Listen, O Yudhishthira! Those ordinances that I have told you of, those, viz., that were first promulgated by the great Rishis Angirasa, and that have reference to meritorious fasts for their soul, are considered as equal to Sacrifices.

sa: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य क्रुद्धो राजन् धनंजयः। भूमिष्ठो वारणगतं योधयामास भारत॥
en: Seeing it advance towards him, o king, Dhananjaya, filled with anger and standing on the earth, O Bharata, met the prince on its back.

sa: शरण्यः सर्वभूतानां विश्वास्यः सर्वजन्तुषु। अनुद्वेगकरो लोके च चाप्युद्विजते सदा॥
en: All creatures seek his protection. He is trusted by all. He never causes any anxiety in others, and himself has never to become anxious,

sa: ततो विपुलमानाय्य देवशर्मा महातपाः। पुष्पार्थे चोदयामास गच्छ गच्छेति भारत॥
en: Summoning Vipula into his presence, Devasharman of severe penances commanded his disciple to bring him some flowers of the same sort, saying Go, go.

sa: इत्यवश्यं मयैतद् वो वक्तव्यं द्विजसत्तमाः। शृणुताव्यग्रमनसः शंसतो मे यथातथम्॥
en: Forsooth, I should say this, O focmost of Brahmanas. Listen to me with rapt attention as I truly describe to you what took place.

sa: वाणिज्यं सत्पथस्थानमातिथ्यं प्रशमो दमः। विप्राणां स्वागतं त्यागो वैश्यधर्मः सनातनः॥
en: Trade, walking in the path of virtue, hospitality, peacefulness, self-control, welcoming of Brahmanas, and renouncing things are the other eternal duties of the Vaishya.

sa: प्रशंसा ह्येव मांसस्य दोषकर्मफलान्विता॥ जीवितं हि परित्यज्य बहवः साधवो जनाः। स्वमासैः परमांसानि परिपाल्य दिवं गताः॥
en: Such pradise even of meat is sinful. Formerly, many pious men, by giving the flesh of their own bodies, protected the flesh of other creatures and as a result of such deeds of merit, have proceeded to the celestial region.

sa: मा स्म शोके मनः कार्षीर्दिष्टेन व्यथते बुधः। श्रुतं देवरहस्यं ते नारदाद् देवदर्शनात्॥
en: Do not set your mind again on sorrow. He who is wise is never moved at ill luck. You have also heard the mysteries of the deities from Narada of celestial form.

sa: कर्मणा मनुजः कुर्वन् हिंसा पार्थिवसत्तम। वाचा च मनसा चैव कथं दुःखात् प्रमुच्यते॥
en: But, o king, what I ask you is this how does a man who has perpetrated acts of injury to others in word, thought and deed, succeed in purifying himself from misery.

sa: पाण्डवैः पृथिवीमश्वो निर्जितामस्त्रतेजसा। चचार स महाराज यथादेशं च सत्तम॥
en: The horse then travelled, foremost of men, wherever he liked over the Earth already conquered by the Pandavas with the power of their weapons.

sa: अथापरे मनुष्येन्द्र पुरुषा वाक्यमब्रुवन्। नैनं पश्याम सम्म धनुरेतत् प्रदृश्यते॥
en: Others, O chief of men, uttered these words :-'So great is the crowd that we do not see Arjuna. His bow, however, we see.

sa: ततः स भगवान् विप्रः समादिश्य नराधिपम्। सुष्वापैकेन पाइँन दिवसानेकविंशतिम्॥
en: Meanwhile the holy Brahmana, having thus commanded the king, slept soundly, without changing his posture or turning even once, for one and twenty days.

sa: यश्चेदं पाण्डवाख्यानं पठेत् पर्वणि पर्वणि। स देवलोकं सम्प्राप्य नन्दने स सुखी वसेत्॥
en: That man, O son of Pandu, who reads this discourse at every full moon and new moon, succeeds in acquiring the celestial region and enjoying great happiness in the bowers of Nandana.

sa: इति ब्रुवन्तीं तां साध्वी भार्यां स द्विजसत्तमः। क्षुधापरिगतां ज्ञात्वा तान् सक्तून् नाभ्यनन्दत॥
en: Knowing that his chaste wife who said so, was herself stricken with hunger, that best of Brahmanas could not approve of her share of the powdered barley being given to the guest.

sa: शब्दः स्पर्शस्तथा रूपं द्रवश्चापां गुणाः स्मृताः॥ रसज्ञानं तु वक्ष्यामि रसस्तु बहुधा स्मृतः।
en: Sound, touch, colour, and taste have been said to be the qualities of water. I shall now speak or the qualities of Taste. Taste has been said to be of various kinds.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच एकः शास्ता न द्वितीयोऽस्ति शास्ता यो हृच्छयस्तमहमनुब्रवीमि। तेनैव युक्तः प्रवणादिवोदकं यथानियुक्तोऽस्मि तथा वहामि।।।।
en: The Brahmana said There is one Ruler. There is no second beside him. He who is Ruler lives in the heart. I shall speak now of him. Moved by Him, I move as directed like water along an inclined plane.

sa: एकादशे तु दिवसे यः प्राप्ते प्राशते हविः। सदा द्वादशमासान् वै जुह्वानो जातवेदसम्॥ परस्त्रियं नाभिलषेद् वाचाथ मनसापि वा। अनृतं च न भोषेत मातापित्रोः कृतेपि वा॥ अभिगच्छेन्महादेवं विमानस्थं महाबलम्। अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य फलं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमम्॥
en: He who fasts for ten days and cats only clarified butter on every eleventh day for one full year and pours libations on his sacred fire every day, who never, in word or thought, seeks the company of other people's wives and who never utters a false hood even for the sake of his mother and father, succeeds in seeing Mahadeva of great power seated on his car. Such a person acquires the great merit of a thousand Horse sacrifices.

sa: गान्धारी च महाभागा प्राज्ञा करुणवेदिनी। पुत्रशोकं महाराज धैर्येणोद्वहते भृशम्॥
en: The highly blessed Gandhari, cndued with great wisdom and kindly speech, bears with fortitude her excessive grief owing to the loss of her sons.

sa: सम्भराश्चैव राजेन्द्र सर्वे संकल्पिताऽभवन्। स सम्भारान् समाहृत्य नृपो धर्मसुतस्तदा॥ न्यवेदयदमेयात्मा कृष्णद्वैपायनाय वै।
en: All the articles necessary for the sacrifice, O king, were duly procured. The royal son of Dharma, gifted with immeasurable soul, having procured all the necessaries, inforined the Island-born Krishna of it.

sa: अपि च ज्ञानसम्पन्नः सर्वान् वेदान् पितुर्गुहे। श्लाघमान इवाधीयाद् ग्राम्य इत्येव तं विदुः॥
en: If remaining in the house of his father he masters all the Vedas and acquiring great knowledge acquires a position that should command respect, people still condemn him as untravelled or home-keeping.

sa: दशन् वै मानुषान्नित्यं पापात्मा स विशाम्पते। घृतं हृत्वा तु दुर्बुद्धिः काकमद्गुः प्रजायते॥
en: He bites human beings every day and, therefore, becomes sinful and passes through a varied round of rebirths. That foolish man who steals clarified butter has to take birth as a gallinule.

sa: निर्मलाभिश्च मुक्ताभिर्मणिभिश्च महाप्रभैः। उद्भूतपुलिनास्तत्र जातरूपैश्च निम्नगाः॥
en: There are rivers whose banks are variegated with many bright pearls and shining gems and gold.

sa: वसिष्ठ उवाच अनध्याये पठल्लोके शुनः स परिकर्षतु। परिव्राट कामवृत्तस्तु बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः॥ शरणागतं हन्तु स वै स्वसुतां चोपजीवतु। अर्थान् काङ्क्षतु कीनाशाद् बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः॥
en: Vasishtha said Let him who had stolen the lotusstalks abstain from reading the Vedas, or leash hounds, or be wandering mendicant unrestrained by the ordinances laid down for that mode of life, or be a destroyer of persons who seek refuge with him, or live upon the proceeds of the sale of his daughter, or solicit riches fro, those who are low and vile.

sa: न हि पुण्यतमं किंचिद् गोभ्यो भरतसत्तम। एताः पुण्याः पवित्राश्च त्रिषु लोकेषु सत्तमाः॥
en: O best of the Bharatas, there is nothing that is more sacred than kine. The highest of all things in the three worlds, kine are themselves sacred and capable of purifying others.

sa: यतः सर्वाणि भूतानि भवन्त्यादियुगागमे। यस्मिंश्च प्रलयं यान्ति पुनरेव युगक्षये॥११॥
en: On the advent of the primitive cycle, all creatures originate from Him. On the expiration, again of the cycle, all things disappear in Him.

sa: पवित्राणां पवित्र यो मङ्गलानां च मङ्गलम्। दैवतं देवतानां च भूतानां योऽव्ययः पिता॥
en: He is the most Holy of all holies, the most sacred of all sacred objects. He is the God of all the gods, and He is the immutabie Father of all creatures.

sa: संवर्त उवाच यदि प्रीतस्त्वमसि वै देवराज तस्मात्स्वयं शाधि यज्ञे विधानम्। स्वयं सर्वान् कुरु भागान् सुरेन्द्र जानात्वयं सर्वलोकश्च देव॥
en: If, O King of the Celestials, you are pleased with us, do you yourself give all the directions for this sacrifice, and, O Surendra, yourself ordain the sacrificial portions (for the gods), so that, O god, all the world may know that it has been done by you.

sa: स्नातानां शुचिभिस्तोयैर्गाङ्गेयैः प्रयतात्मनाम्। व्युष्टिर्भवति या पुंसां न सा क्रतुशतैरपि॥
en: Hundreds of sacrifices cannot yield that merit which men of controlled souls are capable of acquiring by bathing in the sacred waters of Ganga.

sa: नाधिगच्छं यदा पृथ्व्यां मिथिला मार्गिता मया। नाध्यगच्छं यदा तस्यां स्वप्रजा मार्गिता मया॥
en: When I could not find it on the Earth. I then Searched Mithila (for it). When I could not find it in Mithila, 1 then searched for it among my own children.

sa: सामन्तेभ्यः प्रियाण्यस्य कार्याणि सुबहून्यपि। प्राप्यन्तेऽथैः सुलघुभिः सुनयाद् विदुरस्य वै॥
en: Through the excellent policy of Vidura, by the expenditure of very little money, the Pandavas got numerous agreeable services from their feudators and followers.

sa: तदुपश्रुत्य तत् कर्म वासुदेवस्य धीमतः॥ पूजार्ह पूजयामासुः कृष्णं देवकिनन्दनम्।
en: Hearing of that feat of the highly intelligent Vasudeva, they all adored Krishna, the delighter of Devaki, who was every way worthy of adoration.

sa: उमोवाच अपरे स्वल्पविज्ञाना धर्मविद्वेषिणो नराः। ब्राह्मणान् वेदविदुषो नेच्छन्ति परिसर्पितम्॥
en: Uma said There are men who hate virtue and who are gifted with little understandings. Thcy never wish to approach Brahmanas knowing the Vedas.

sa: सोपाविशद् रथोपस्थे तव पुत्रेण ताडितः॥ रुधिराप्लुतसर्वाङ्ग आशीविष इव श्वसन्।
en: Thus struck by your son, Sahadeva sat down on his car, all his limbs being covered with blood and himself breathing like a snake.

sa: वेदवेदाङ्गवित् प्राज्ञः सुतपस्वी नृपो भवेत्। दानशीलश्च सततं यज्ञशीलश्च भारत॥
en: The king should master the Vedas and their auxiliaries, be possessed of wisdom, engaged in penances, charitable, and devoted to the celebration of sacrifices.

sa: वासयन्त्यतिथीन् नित्यं नित्यं ये चानसूयकाः। नित्यं स्वाध्यायशीलाश्च दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति ते॥
en: Those, who always treat guests hospitably, those, who do not cherish malice, those, who constantly read the Vedas, succeed in getting over all difficulties.

sa: हत्वा शतसहस्राणि निशितैः शरैः। न्यस्तशस्त्रो मम पिता धृष्टद्युम्नेन पातितः॥
en: When my father having killed hundreds and thousands of warriors with sharp arrows, had thrown out his weapons, he was then killed by Dhrishtadyumna.

sa: सम्यक् प्रणयतो दण्डं भूमिपस्य विशाम्पते। युक्तस्य वा नास्त्यधर्मो धर्म एव हि शाश्वतः॥
en: A king, O monarch, who inflicts punishments duly and according to the dictates of the science of punishment, commits no sin by the act. On the other hand, he acquires eternal merit.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यैर्हतानि शरीराणि हृष्टैः परमसंयुगे। देवराजसमाल्लोकान् गतास्ते सत्यविक्रमः॥
en: Yudhishthira said Those truly powerful warriors that have cheerfully met with death in fierce battle, have all attained to regions like those of Indra.

sa: सुव्रतं सत्यसंघं च ददौ मित्रौ महात्मने। कुमाराय महात्मानौ तपोविद्याधरौ प्रभुः॥ सुदर्शनीयौ वरदौ त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतौ।
en: The lord Mitra gave the high-souled Kumara two illustrious companions named Suvrata and Satyasandha both of whom were highly learned and endued with ascetic merit, possessed of handsome features, capable of granting boons and well known over the three worlds.

sa: सिंहव्याघ्रगणाः क्रूरा मत्ताश्चैव महागजाः। द्वीपिनः खङ्गभल्लूका ये चान्ये भीमदर्शनाः॥ ते सुखप्रश्नदाः सर्वे भवन्ति क्षतजाशनाः। तस्यर्षे: शिष्यवच्चैव न्यग्भूताः प्रियकारिणः॥
en: Dreadful lions and tigers, infuriate elephants of huge body, leopards, rhinoceroses, bears, and other dreadful animals, living upon blood, used to come to the Rishi and question him politely. Indeed, all of them behaved towards him like disciples and slaves and always did what was agreeable to him.,

sa: वषट्कारोऽभवज्या तु धनुषस्तस्य भारत। यज्ञाङ्गानि च चत्वारि तस्य संनहनेऽभवन्॥
en: the sacred (mantra) Vashat, O Bharata, was made its string. The four parts, of which a Sacrifice consists, became the ornaments of that bow.

sa: छिद्यमानस्य महतो वनस्येव परश्वधैः। शुश्रुषे सुमहाशब्दो बलस्य तव भारत॥
en: While your army was being killed like a forest hewn down with axes, a loud cry of lamentation was heard rising from your camp.

sa: बन्दिभिः सततं काले स्तुवद्भिरभिनन्दिताः। शिवानामशिवा घोराः शृण्वन्ति विविधा गिरः॥
en: Recounting their praises poets used to place them before at proper times. They are now listening to the fierce and inauspicious yells of jackals.

sa: योधयित्वा महाबाहुरेष पार्थं धनंजयम्। संशयं गमयित्वा च कुन्तीपुत्रेण पातितः॥
en: Having fought Dhananjaya ine son of Pritha, and brought him to a perilous condition,। this mighty-armed one, was at last killed by his antagonist.

sa: द्रौणिरुवाच पाण्डवैर्यानि रत्नानि यच्चान्यत् कौरवैर्धनम्। अवाप्तमिह तेभ्योऽयं मणिर्मम विशिष्यते॥
en: Drona's son said This my gem is more valuable than all the wealth that has ever been acquired by the Pandavas and the Kauravas.

sa: ततस्तेषु प्रयातेषु शकुनिः सौबलः पुनः॥ पार्श्वतोऽभ्यहनत् क्रुद्धो धृष्टद्युम्नस्य वाहिनीम्।
en: After all those had departed Shakuni the son of Subala, worked up with wrath, once more attacked. Dhrishtadyumna's division and began to strike it.

sa: एष शैलालयो राजा भगदत्तः प्रतापवान्। गजाङ्कुशधरः श्रीमाशेते भुवि निपातितः॥
en: There the highly powerful king Bhagadatta, the king of a mountainous kingdom, the foremost of all holders of good, lies dead on the Earth.

sa: चाल्यमानं तु तं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवानां बलार्णवम्॥ विस्मयं परमं जग्मुर्देवगन्धर्वदानवाः।
en: And when they saw the vest host of the Pandavas agitated by that hero, the gods and the Gandharvas were stricken with great wonder.

sa: नातिदूरं ततो गत्वा नगं तालध्वजो बली॥ पुण्यं तीर्थवरं दृष्ट्वा विस्मयं परमं गतः।
en: The powerful Valarama having the emblem of the palmyra of his banner had not ascended far when he saw a sacred and goodly Tirtha and was stricken with wonder at the sight.

sa: नित्ययुक्ताश्च ते भृत्या भवन्तु रणकोविदाः। वाजिनां च प्रयोगेषु वैशारद्यमिहेष्यते॥
en: Let your servants, skilled in battle, always attend to their duties. It is desirable that they should be skilful in the management of horses.

sa: यत्रादृष्टं भयं ब्रह्म प्रजानां शमयत्युत। दृष्टं च राजा बाहुभ्यां तद् राज्यं सुखमेधते॥
en: That kingdom truly enjoys felicity where the invisible fears of the subjects, are removed by the Brahmana and all visible ones are suppressed by the king with the strength of his arin.

sa: शरीरमपि राजेन्द्र तस्य कानिष्ठिकासमम्। ग्रीवा बाहू तथा पादौ केशाश्चाद्भुतदर्शनाः॥
en: His body, O king, was as thin as one's little finger. His neck and arms and legs and hair were all of extraordinary character.

sa: हा हा धिग् दुःशलां पश्य वीतशोकभयामिव। शिरो भर्तुरनासाद्य धावमानामितस्ततः॥
en: Alas, alas, see, my daughter Dusshala having cast off her grief and fears, is running about in search of the head of her husband.

sa: न स्मराम्यपराधं ते किं मां न प्रतिभाषसे। ननु मां त्वं पुरा दूरादभिवीक्ष्याभिभाषसे॥
en: I do not remember to have ever offered you. Why do you not speak to me then? Formerly, you used to addressed me even when you would see me at a distance.

sa: पुनरज्ञातचर्यायां कीचकेन पदा वधम्। कथं विस्मृतवानसि॥
en: Why have you forgotten the princess Draupadi kicked by Kichaka while we were living in concealment?

sa: तत आहूय राजानं संजयं जयतां वरम्। पर्वतोऽनुमतो वाक्यमुवाच कुरुपुङ्गव॥
en: After this, Parvata having summoned king Srinjaya, that foremost of victorious persons, said to him these words, O foremost of Kurus:प्रीतौ स्वो नृप सत्कारैर्भवदार्जवसम्भृतैः।

sa: आत्मारामः प्रसन्नात्मा जडान्धवधिराकृतिः। अकुर्वाणः परैः काञ्चित् संविदं जातु कैरपि॥
en: Without talking with anybody, I shall outwardly appear as a blind and deaf idiot, while living in contentment and deriving liappiness from my innerself.

sa: नाहं प्रमाणं नैव त्वमन्योन्यं कारणं शुभे। कालो नित्यमुपादत्ते सुखं दुःखं च देहिनाम्॥
en: O blessed lady, I am, therefore, not the cause of your sorrow, nor are you the cause of inine. It is time which always ordains the happiness and misery of embodied creatures.

sa: ततः पार्था महेष्वासाः सात्वताभिसृतं नृपम्। अभ्यवर्तन रथैस्तूर्णं मातुलं वधकाझ्या॥
en: Beholding the king of the Madras struck by Satyaki those great bowmen the Parthas, quickly rushed towards him with a view to kill him.

sa: कश्यप उवाच एवमस्मिन्वर्तते लोक एव नामुत्रं वर्तते राजपुत्र। प्रेत्यैतयोरन्तरावान्विशेषो यो वै पुण्यं चरते यश्च पापम्॥
en: Kashyapa said Such, indeed, is the course of this world, O prince. It is not so, however, in another world. In the other world, there is a great difference between the person that acts virtuously and him that acts sinfully.

sa: ये त्वेकरतयो नित्यं धीराश्च प्रियवादिनः। परस्परस्य सुहृदः समन्तात् समदर्शिनः॥
en: They should be devotedly loyal and utter sweet words in addressing kings. They should also be friendly towards one another, and regard all impartially.

sa: ततोऽभवचतुर्मूतिः क्षणेन भगवान् प्रभुः॥ तस्य शाखो विशाखश्च नैगमेयश्च पृष्ठतः।
en: The worshipful and powerful lord assumed those four forms in a instant. The three forms that stood behind were Shakra and Vishakha and Naigameya.

sa: स तु बालोऽपि बलवान महायोगबलान्वितः॥ अभ्याजगाम देवेशं शूलहस्तं पिनाकिनम्।
en: Gifted with great strength and great ascetic power, the child proceeded before that lord of the gods, viz., Mahadeva, armed with trident and Pinaka.

sa: अप्रियं यस्य कुर्वीत भूयस्तस्य प्रियं चरेत्। नचिरेण प्रियः स स्याद् योऽप्रियः प्रियमाचरेत्॥
en: If you do evil to any person, you should, when the times comes, do him good. One who is not loved becomes an object of love if he does what is good.

sa: यस्मिन् प्रशासति महीं नृपतौ राजसत्तम। अकृष्टपच्या पृथिवी विबभौ चैत्यमालिनी॥
en: During the reign of that king, O best of kings, Earth produced crops without being tilled and was adorned with various kinds of ornaments.

sa: उषित्वा रजनीं तत्र माधवः परवीरहा। पूज्य तोयं च लागली॥
en: Passing one night there, that killer of hostile heroes, viz., Madhava, lauding that foremost of Tirthas and touching its water, became cheerful and happy.

sa: अन्यत्र वधकालात् ते सदृशेन समीयुषः। अब्राह्मणे न हि ब्रह्म ध्रुवं तिष्ठेत् कदाचन॥
en: Since you are not a Brahmana, this Brahma weapon shall not, up to the time of your death, live in you when you will be engaged with a warrior equal to yourself.

sa: गृहाणीव हि मानामाहुर्देहानि पण्डिताः। कालेन विनियुज्यन्ते सत्त्वमेकं तु शाश्वतम्॥
en: The learned say that the bodies of men are like house, which are destroyed in time. There is one being, however, that is eternal.

sa: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं मुखं प्रच्छाद्य वाससा॥ पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्ता गान्धारी प्ररुरोद ह।
en: having said so Gandhari, burning in grief for the death of her sons, covered her face with her cloth and began to weep aloud.

sa: श्रीमद्राजपुरं नाम नगरं तत्र भारत। राजानः शतशस्तत्र कन्यार्थे समुपागमन्॥
en: That prosperous city, O Bharata, was known by the name of Rajapura. Hundreds of kings went there for securing the hand of the maiden.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच एकश्चैद् योद्धमाक्रन्दे शूरोऽद्य मम दीयताम्॥ आयुधानामियं चापि वृता त्वत्सम्मते गदा।
en: Duryodhana said Brave as you are, if you allow me the option of fighting only one of you, this mace, that I have in my hand, is the weapon that I select.

sa: तं प्रजा नानुवर्तन्ते ब्राह्मणा न च साधवः। ततः संशयमाप्नोति तथा वध्यत्वमेति च॥
en: The subjects do not follow such a king. Brahmanas and all pious persons also do the same. As a consequence the king incurs grave danger, and ultimately the risk of his life.

sa: गाण्डीवमुक्तैस्तु सुवर्णपुजैः शिलाशितैः शोणितदिग्धवाजैः। शरैश्चिताङ्गो युधि भाति कर्णो हतोऽपि सन् सूर्य इवांशुमाली॥
en: Although killed and wounded with goldwinged arrows, whetted on stone and adorned with blood-dyed feathers, shot off the Gandiva, the heroic Karna lying on earth looked like the sun of bright rays.

sa: ततस्ताभ्यो ददावन्नमोषधी: स्थावराणि च। जङ्गमानि च भूतानि दुर्बलानि बलीयसाम्॥
en: Then the Grandfather gave herbs and plants and other vegetables as their food, and assigned for the strong the weaker creatures as their food.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच किमर्थं तप्यसे पुत्र श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः। श्रुत्वा त्वामनुनेष्यामि यदि सम्यग् भविष्यति॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Why do you grieve, O son! I wish to hear the cause fully. If after hearing the reasons they appear to be sufficient, I shall then try to instruct you.

sa: स सख्यमकरोद् बाल्ये राज्ञा दुर्योधनेन च। युष्माभिनित्यसंद्विष्टो दैवाच्चापि स्वभावतः॥
en: In early age he contracted friendship with king Duryodhana, led by accident and his own nature and the hate he cherished against you all.

sa: अतिप्रवृत्ते युद्धे च छिद्यमानेषु मर्मसु। धावमानेषु योधेषु जयगृद्धिषु मारिष॥
en: The very vitals of the combatants were being struck, during that fight and the troops, O sire, desirous of victory, were rushing with speed.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा कृष्णद्वैपायनः प्रभुः। पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्तं पुत्रं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing these words of his the powerful Vyasa thus spoke to his son stricken with grief on account of the death of his children.

sa: व्यास उवाच प्रजानां पालनं धर्मो राज्ञां राजीवलोचन। धर्मः प्रमाणं लोकस्य नित्यं धर्मानुवर्तिनः॥
en: Vyasa said 'O you having eyes like lotus petals, the protection of subjects is the duty of kings. Those men who are always observant of duty regard duty to be all powerful.

sa: यूयं ससुहृदः पार्थाः सर्वे सरथवाहनाः। अहमेकः परियूनो विस्थो हतवाहनः॥
en: Duryodhana said O Parthas, all of you have friends cars and animals. I, however, am alone, today without a car and without an animal.

sa: यावत्यः सिकता राजन् गङ्गायां पुरुषर्षभ। तावतीरेव गाः प्रादादामूर्तरयसो गयः॥
en: That foremost of men viz., Gaya the son Amurtarayas, distributed as many kine as there are sand grains, O king in the river Ganga.

sa: तपसा भगवान् विष्णुराविवेश च भूमिपम्। देववन्नरदेवानां नमते यं जगन्नृपम्॥
en: The divine Vishnu entered the body of that king for his penances. Therefore the entire universe adored Prithu who was the greatest of kings.

sa: किं तस्य तपसा राज्ञः किं च तस्याध्वरैरपि। सुपालितप्रजो यः स्यात् सर्वधर्मविदेव सः॥
en: Of what use are penances to that king, and what need has he of sacrifices who protects his people properly? Such a king should be known as one conversant with every virtue.

sa: सर्वो दण्डजितो लोको दुर्लभो हि शुचिर्जनः। दण्डस्य हि भयाद् भीतो भोगायैव प्रवर्तते॥
en: Every one in this world is kept all right by chastisement. A person by nature pure and pious is rare. In fear of chastisement, man becomes disposed to observe rules and restrictions.

sa: एवमारण्यशास्त्राणामुग्रमुग्रतरं विधिम्। सेवमानः प्रतीक्षिष्ये देहस्यास्य समापनम्॥
en: Thus leading an austere forest-life, I shall live on, calmly awaiting the dissolution of my body.

sa: संन्यासकृतबुद्धि तं ततो दृष्ट्वा महातपाः॥ सर्वाश्चास्य क्रियाश्चक्रे विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा।
en: The holy personage of hard austerities, seeing him thus determined, performed all the sacred rites according to the injunctions laid down for that purpose.

sa: मुहूर्तमिव च ध्यात्वा नारदो देवदर्शनः। उवाच पाण्डवान् सर्वान् हतशिष्टांश्च पार्थिवान्॥ प्राप्तकालं समाचक्षे भीष्मोऽयमनुयुज्यताम्। अस्तमेति हि गाङ्गेयो भानुमानिव भारत॥
en: Then reflecting for a moment, Narada, of divine features, addressed all the Pandavas and the residue of the kings, saying, 'The time, I think, has come for you to question Bhishma for Ganga's son is about to die like the Sun that is on the point of setting.

sa: तस्मादस्य निवृत्त्यर्थं यत्नमेवाचरेद् बुधः। उपेक्षा नात्र कर्तव्या शतशाखः प्रवर्धते॥
en: He that is wise should certainly prevent the coming of re-birth. One should not neglect it, for indifference may subject us to it repeatedly.

sa: परिष्वजेथा राजानं बाह्निकं सुमहारथम् सैन्धवं सोमदत्तं च भूरिश्रवसमेव च। तथा पूर्वगतानन्यान् स्वर्गे पार्थिवसत्तमान्॥ अस्मद्वाक्यात् सम्पृच्छेस्त्वमनामयम्॥
en: Embrace king Valhika, that great carwarrior, as also the king of the Sindhus, and Somadatta, and Bhruishravas, and the other foremost of kings gone before you to heaven. At my request, embrace all of them and enquire after their well-being.

sa: निषण्णो भवेद् रात्रौ दिवा भवति विष्ठितः। इष्टानिष्टस्य च द्रष्टा तस्मै द्रष्ट्रात्मने नमः॥
en: You sleep not in the night. You are engaged in day time also. You witness the good and the bad actions (of all), Salutations to you in your form of (universal) observer.

sa: अब्रवीच तदा रामो दृष्ट्वा कृष्णं सपाण्डवम्। दुर्योधनं च कौरव्यं गदापाणिमवस्थितम्॥ चत्वारिंशदहान्यद्य द्वे च मे निःसृतस्य वै। पुष्येण सम्प्रयातोऽस्मि श्रवणे पुनरागतः॥ शिष्ययोर्वै गदायुद्ध द्रष्टकामोऽस्मि माधव।
en: Looking at Krishna and the Pandavas and also at Duryodhana of Kuru's race who was standing there armed with mace, Rama then said-"Two and forty days have passed since I left home. I had set out under the constellation Pushya and have come back under Shravana. I am desirous, O Madhava, of witnessing this encounter with the mace between these two disciples of mine."

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्ततो राजा प्राप्तकालमचिन्तयत्। तत्र ते गमनं प्राप्तं रोचते तव माधव॥ गान्धार्याः क्रोधदीप्तायाः प्रशमार्थमरिंदम। हेतुकारणयुक्तैश्च वाक्यैः कालसमीरितैः॥ क्षिप्रमेव महाभाग गान्धारी प्रशमिष्यसि। पितामहश्च भगवान् व्यासस्तत्र भविष्यति॥
en: King Yudhishthira then brought to his mind, the outright action with the time and said O enemy suppressor Madhava! It appears all good to visit at Hastinapura in order to pacify Gandhari who is burning with anger. O noble lord! You will only able to pacify Gandhari by referring to reasonable and time matching things to her. Our grand-father Vyasa will also present there.

sa: कामक्रोधावनादृत्य पितेव समदर्शनः। शास्त्रजां बुद्धिमास्थाय युज्यते नैनसा हि सः॥
en: That king who, following the scriptural injunctions and disregarding lust and anger, behaves impartially, like a father, towards all his subjects, never incurs sin.

sa: निबोधैनं सुदुर्बुद्धिं मातुलं कलहप्रियम्। क्षिप्रमेनं परित्यज्य पुत्र शाम्यस्व पाण्डवैः॥
en: Know your maternal uncle to be very wicked and greatly fond of quarrel. Discard him forthwith and make peace with the Pandavas, O son.

sa: सत्यवत्युवाच इच्छल्लोकानपि मुने सृजेथाः किं पुनः सुतम्। शामात्मकमजुं पुत्रं दातुमर्हसि मे प्रभो॥
en: If you wish, O sage, you can create other worlds, what shall I say of a child? You should, O powerful one, give me a son who will be pious and peaceful.

sa: एवं प्रभावो धर्मात्मा जैगीषव्यस्तथासितः। तयोरिदं स्थानवरं तीर्थं चैव महात्मनोः॥
en: Such was the power of Jaigishavya as also of Asita. Here lived those two and this is the Tirtha of those two great persons.

sa: ततः सहस्रं विप्राणां चतुर्वेदविदां तथा। गवां सहस्रेणैकैकं वाचयामास माधवः॥
en: Distributing a thousand kine amongst a thousand Brahmanas all of whom were masters of the four Vedas, he made them utter benedictions upon him.

sa: तथा भीमगदावैगैस्ताड्यमानो मुहुर्मुहुः। शल्यो न विव्यथे राजन् दन्तिनेव महागिरिः॥
en: Similarly, though struck again and again with Bhima's mace, Shalya, O king, moved not like a mountain struck by an elephant with his tusks.

sa: मृदुनैव मृदुं हन्ति मृदुना हन्ति दारुणम्। नासाध्यं मृदुना किंचित् तस्मात् तीक्ष्णतरो मृदुः॥
en: By mildness the mild should be conquered. By mildness one may destroy that which is dreadful. There is nothing which mildness cannot do. Therefore, mildness is said to be sharper than fierceness.

sa: हृष्टाः सुमनसश्चैव बभूवुस्तत्र सैनिकाः। मेनिरे निहतान् पार्थान् मद्रराजवशं गतान्॥
en: Indeed your soldiers were filled with delight. They considered the Parthas as already slain and brought under the control of the king of Madras.

sa: सोऽभिषिक्तो महाराज परिष्वज्य नृपोत्तमम्। प्रययौ सिंहनादेन दिशः सर्वा विनादयन्॥
en: After the ceremony, O King, Ashvathaman embraced that best of kings and left the place, having resounded the ten cardinal points with his war-cry.

sa: ततः प्रीतमना रामः श्रुत्वा तीर्थफलं महत्। विप्राणां संनिधौ श्लोकमगायदिममच्युतः॥
en: Having listened to the discourse of the sages about the great merits of Tirthas, Rama sang this verse in the midst of the Brahmanas.

sa: एतान् मयोक्तांश्चर राजधर्मान् नृणां च गुप्तौ मतिमादधत्स्व। अवाप्स्यसे पुण्यफलं सुखेन सर्वो हि लोको नृप धर्ममूलः॥
en: Do you practise these duties of kings that I have described to you. Be ready to perform the duty of protecting men. You may then easily acquire the need of virtue. All the regions of happiness hereafter depend upon merit.'

sa: तस्मिन् हते महेष्वासे हतशिष्टास्त्रयो रथाः। संरम्भान्निशि राजेन्द्र जघ्नुः पाञ्चालसोमकान्॥
en: After his destruction in that great battle three car warriors who were still alive, worked up with great anger, killed the Panchalas in night.

sa: अनुयास्यावहे त्वां तु प्रभाते सहितावुभौ। अद्य रात्रौ विश्रमस्व विमुक्तकवचध्वजः॥ अहं त्वामनुयास्यामि कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः। परानभिमुखं यान्तं रथावास्थाय दंशितौ॥
en: Both of us, however, shall accompany you in the morning putting off armours and taking down your standard rest for this night. I shall, clad in mail and riding on our cars, accompany you as also Kritavarman of the Satwata race, while you will proceed against the foe.

sa: प्रविश्य समरे शूरः पाण्डवानामनीकिनीम्। स वीरशयने शेते परः सत्पुरुषोचिते॥
en: Having in battle penetrated the ranks of the Pandavas army, that hero now sleeps on the bed of a most exalted and heroic Kshatriya.

sa: यः शेते योगमास्थाय पर्यङ्के नागभूषिते। फणासहस्ररचिते तस्मै निद्रात्मने नमः॥
en: You sleep in Yoga on your snake sofa formed by the thousand hoods (of the Naga). Salutations to you in your forms of sleep.

sa: युवा वृन्दारको नित्यं प्रवरस्त्रीनिषेवितः। विर्विशतिरसौ शेते ध्वस्तः पांसुषु माधव॥
en: Young and beautiful, and always waited upon and served by the most handsome ladies, my son Vivinshati, O Madhava, sleeps there, covered with dust.

sa: हेतुकारणसंयुक्तैर्वाक्यैः कालसमीरितैः। क्षिप्रमेव महाबाहो गान्धारी शमयिष्यसि॥
en: With reasonable words, you will quickly, O you of great wisdomn, be able to pacify Gandhari.

sa: कुतश्चापीदृशं पापाः प्रवर्तिष्यामहे वयम्॥ यादृशेन पुरस्कृत्य त्वं गतः सर्वपार्थिवान्।
en: Where shall such sinful persons as ourselves now go, since you have gone to heaven taking with you all the kings of the Earth?

sa: तैः समन्तात् परिवृतः कुञ्जरैः पर्वतोपमैः। नाराचैर्विमलैस्तीक्ष्णैर्गजानीकमयोधयत्॥
en: Surrounded by mountain-like elephants he began to destroy those animals with his keen and polished arrows.

sa: उत्थानं च मनुष्याणां दक्षाणां दैववर्जितम्। अफलं दृश्यते लोके सम्यगप्युपपादितम्॥
en: The exertion, however, of even a capable man, even when well-directed, is, without the help of destiny, seen to be fruitless in the world.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। निदर्शनं परं लोके सज्जनाचरिते सदा॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the following ancient history. That history is considered as one of the greatest precedent amongst good and wisemen.

sa: हत्वा राजसहस्राणि बहून्याशुपराक्रमः। तद् व्यर्थं सम्प्रपश्यामि मोहात् तव जनाधिप॥
en: Having killed many thousands of powerful kings, I see, O monarch, that through your folly you are about to make such an attachment futile.

sa: आत्मनश्चपलो नास्ति कुतोऽन्येषां भविष्यति॥ तस्मात् सर्वाणि कार्याणि चपलो हन्त्यसंशयम्।
en: A person, who has no sense, cannot protect his own self. How can be protect others? Such a person, forsooth, ruins all his acts.

sa: ते सर्वे मामभिप्रेक्ष्य तूर्णमश्वाननोदयन्। उपायाय तु मामूचुर्दिष्ट्या जीवसि संजय॥
en: Seeing me, they all urged their horses to greater speed and coming up to me, said-By good luck, O Sanjaya, you are still alive.

sa: चित्रसेनं हतं भूमौ शयानं मधुसूदन। धार्तराष्ट्रमिमं पश्य प्रतिमानं धनुष्मताम्॥
en: Look, O slayer of Madhu, at that other son of Dhritarashtra, viz., Chitrasena, the best of all bowmen, slain and lying on the ground.

sa: जघने युध्यमानं हि कौन्तेयो मां समन्ततः। नोत्सहेदभ्यतिक्रान्तुं वेलामिव महोदधिः॥
en: Like the ocean that cannot go beyond its continents, Kunti's son Dhananjaya will never dare go before me if I stand in the fear.

sa: नापत्रपेत प्रश्नेषु नाविभाव्यां गिरं सृजेत्। न त्वरेत न चासूयेत् तथा संगृह्यते परः॥
en: Do not reply harshly when questioned by anybody. Do not utter mean words. Never be in a hurry to do anything. Never cherish malice. By such means an enemy is won over.

sa: बहवो ग्रामवास्तव्या रोषाद् ब्रूयुः परस्परम्। न तेषां वचनाद् राजा सत्कुर्याद् घातयीत वा॥
en: It is seen that moved by jealousy and anger many persons, living in villages and towns, vilify one another. The king should never, as said by them, honour or punish any body.

sa: द्वैपायनो नारदश्च देवलश्च महानृषिः। देवस्थानश्च कण्वश्च तेषां शिष्याश्च सत्तमाः॥
en: Among them were the Dvaipayana Vyasa, Narada, the great Rishi Devala, Devasthana, and Kanva. They had in their company the best of their pupils.

sa: भिक्षुको विचरिष्येते शोचन्तौ पृथिवीमिमाम्। धिगस्तु कृष्णं वार्ष्णेयमर्जुनं चापि दुर्मतिम्॥
en: Stricken with grief, they will have to travel over the Earth, begging their food! Fie on the Vrishni hero Krishna, and on wicked Arjuna.

sa: नात्यन्तं गुणवत् किंचिन्न चाप्यत्यन्तनिर्गुणम्। उभयं सर्वकार्येषु दृश्यते साध्वसाधु वा॥
en: There is no act that is entirely pure, nor any that is entirely simple. In all acts, right or wrong, something of both prevails.

sa: काम नैतत् तवाख्येयं प्राणिनां प्रभवाप्ययौ। उपदेष्टुं भवाशक्तो देवानामपि भारत॥
en: Surely, pain cannot be said to assail you, You can, O Bharata, instruct the very celestials regarding the origin and dissolution of living creatures.

sa: अस्मत्तस्तदुपादाय दिव्यमस्त्रं यदूत्तम। ममात्यस्त्रं प्रयच्छ त्वं चक्रं रिपुहणं रणे॥
en: O foremost one of Yadu, in exchange for that celestial weapon, give me your discus which is capable of killing all enemies in battle.

sa: व्याधिना चाभिपन्नस्य मानसेनेतरेण वा। धर्मज्ञश्च कृतज्ञश्च त्वद्विधः शरणं भवेत्॥
en: One like you who are conversant with morality and full of gratefulness is the refuge of a person suffering from disease mental or physical.

sa: जयशब्दं तथा चक्रुर्देवा: सर्वे सवासवाः। गन्धर्वा यक्षरक्षांसि मनुयः पितरस्तथा॥
en: The gods then, with Vasava at their head and the Gandharvas, the Yakshas, the Rakshasas, the Munis and the Pitris, all exclaimed-"Victory of Skanda.'

sa: सात्यकिस्तु ततः क्रुद्धो दर्मपुत्रे शरार्दिते॥ मद्राणामधिपं शूरं शरैविव्याध पञ्चभिः।
en: Then Satyaki, enraged upon beholding the son of Dharma thus assailed with arrows, obstructed the heroic king of the Madras with clouds of arrows.

sa: स तत्र ववृधे लोकानावृत्य ज्वलनात्मजः। ददृशुर्चलनाकारं तं गर्भमथ कृत्तिकाः॥
en: Thereupon Agni's son began to grow there, overpowering all the worlds by his energy. Meanwhile the six Krittikas saw that child of fiery splendour.

sa: कृच्छ्रेण तु ततो राजा धृतराष्ट्रो महीपतिः॥ शनैरलभत प्राणान् पुत्रव्यसनकर्शितः।
en: Then king Dhritarashtra, that lord of Earth, afflicted with the misery of the death of his sons, slowly and with difficulty regained his life-breaths.

sa: अगम्यागमने राजन् प्रायश्चित्तं विधीयते। । आर्द्रवस्त्रेण षण्मासान् विहार्य भस्मशायिना॥
en: By having intercourse with one whom intercourse is forbidden, the expiation consists in wandering in wet clothes and sleeping on a bed of ashes.

sa: उक्तान्येतानि कर्माणि यानि कुर्वन्न दुष्यति। प्रायश्चित्तानि वक्ष्यामि विस्तरेमैव भारत॥
en: I have grow described those acts by doing which one does not commit sin. I shall now speak to you of expiation in detail.

sa: भिन्दंश्छिन्दन् रुजन् कृन्तन् दारयन् पाटयंस्तथा। घातयन्नभिधावंश्च दण्ड एव चरत्युत॥
en: Indeed, Punishment moves on Earth, piercing and cutting and assenting and looping off and dividing and striking and killing and rushing against its victims.

sa: कामन्दक उवाच यो धर्मार्थी परित्यज्य काममेवानुवर्तते। स धर्मार्थपरित्यागात् प्रज्ञानाशमिहार्छति॥
en: Kamanda said That man, who renouncing Virtue and Profit, pursues only Pleasure, reaps as the result of such conduct the destruction of his intelligence.

sa: यजस्व विविधैर्यज्ञैर्युध्यस्वारीन् प्रयच्छ च। धनानि भोगान् वासांसि द्विजातिभ्यो नृपोत्तम॥
en: Worship the gods with various sacrifices. Fight your foes! Present wealth, clothes and other objects of enjoyment to the Brahmanas, O foremost of kings!

sa: ईषदुत्स्मयमानस्तु कृष्णो राजानमब्रवीत्। युधिष्ठिरं हतामित्रं कृताञ्जलिरथाच्युत॥
en: Joining his hands and addressing Yudhishthira, whose enemies had been killed, Krishna alias Achyuta, smilingly said-

sa: जन्मकर्मविहीना ये कदर्या ब्रह्मबन्धवः। एते शूद्रसमा राजन् ब्राह्मणानां भवन्त्युत॥
en: Those, however, who are not well-born and do not follow the duties of their order, and are, addicted to evil practices, are like Shudras.

sa: स्वेषु धर्मेष्ववस्थाप्य प्रजाः सर्वा महीपतिः। धर्मेण सर्वकृत्यानि शमनिष्ठानि कारयेत्॥
en: Compelling all his subjects to follow their respective duties, a king should make all of them do everything according to the dictates of righteousness.

sa: तदभ्रमिव वातेन क्षिप्यमाणं समन्ततः। अभज्यत महाराज पाण्डूनां सुमहद् बलम्॥
en: The huge force of the Pandus then, O king, were dispersed even as a mass of clouds of all sides by a powerful wind.

sa: अन्योन्यं तौ जिघांसन्तौ प्रवीरौ पुरुषर्षभौ। युयुधाते गरुत्मन्तौ तथा नागामिषैषिणौ॥
en: Desirous of killing each other, those two best of men, possessed of great heroism, fought like two Garudas desirous of catching the same snake.

sa: भुजावुच्छ्रित्य शस्त्रं च शब्देन महता ततः॥ अभ्यद्रवन् महाराज दुर्योधनपुरोगमाः।
en: Raising up arms, taking weapons and making a loud noise, O king, your warriors, led by Duryodhana, rushed against the army of the Pandavas.

sa: ते समर्थान् पूजयेद् यश्च नास्पर्धेः स्पर्धते च यः। न च कामाद् भयात् क्रोधाल्लोभाद् वा धर्ममुत्सृजेत्।। अमानी सत्यवान् क्षान्तो जितात्मा मानसंयुतः। स मन्त्रसहायः स्यात् सर्वावस्थापरीक्षितः॥
en: He, again, who honours all able persons that never cherishes feelings of rivalry with meritorious persons, who never forsakes righteousness from lust or fear or anger or covetousness, who is humble, who is truthful and forgiving, who has his mind under control, who has a sense of dignity, and who has been tried in every situation, should be appointed by you as your counsellor.

sa: नामात्यसुहृदां वाक्यं न च श्रुतवतां श्रुतम्। न रत्नानि पराानि न भून द्रविणागमः॥
en: They did not listen to the counsels of ministers and friends and men well read in the scriptures. They could not, indeed, enjoy their rich gems and well-equipped treasury and vast territories.

sa: प्रजापतेः कर्दमस्य त्वनङ्गो नाम वै सुतः। प्रजा रक्षयिता साधुर्दण्डनीतिविशारदः॥
en: The lord of creatures, Kardama, begot a son named Ananga, who became a protector of creatures, pious and well-read in the science of punishment.

sa: उक्तवांस्त्वां तदैवाहं भीष्मद्रोणौ च भारत। विदुरः संजयश्चैव वाक्यं राजन् न तत् कृथाः॥
en: I spoke this to you before the battle. Both Bhishma and Drona, O Bharata, did the same, as also Vidura and Sanjaya. You did not, however, then care to follow our advice.

sa: मायया चाक्षिपत् तेजो वृत्रस्य बलसूदनः। तस्मान्मायामयं भीम आतिष्ठतु पराक्रमम्॥
en: The destroyer of Vala deprived Vritra his energy by an act of deception. Therefore, let Bhimasena put forth his prowess, by means of deception!

sa: विजेष्यामो वयं सर्वे विश्रान्ता विगतकुमाः॥ भवन्तश्च परिश्रान्तां वयं च भृशविक्षताः। उदीर्णं च बलं तेषां तेन युद्धं न रोचये॥
en: After we have taken rest for a while and removed our fatigue, we shall meet the enemy and defeat him. You also are tired and I myself am greatly wounded. The army of the Pandavas is increasing in strength. And therefore I do not like to fight now.

sa: कीर्तिमांस्तस्य पुत्रोऽभत् सोऽपि पञ्चातिगोऽभवत्। कर्दमस्तस्य तु सुतः सोऽप्यतप्यन्महत् तपः॥
en: Virajas had a son named Krittimat. He too cast off pleasure and enjoyment. Krittimat had a son named Kardama. Kardama also practised severe austerities.

sa: तेषु यः समयं कश्चित् कुर्वीत हतबुद्धिषु॥ यथा काकाश्च गृध्राश्च तथैवोपधिजीविनः। अर्ध्वं देहविमोक्षात् ते भवन्त्येतासु योनिषु॥
en: He, who promises to kill those persons of lost senses, should keep his promise. Such sinners are like the crow and the vulture who live by deceit. When their bodies are dissolved, they are born again as crows and vultures.

sa: शुक्ले देवान् पितृन् कृष्णे तर्पयत्यमृतेन यः यश्च राजा द्विजातीनां तस्मै सोमात्मने नमः॥
en: Salutations to you in your form of Soma who is the highest of Rishis and who gratified with nectar the gods in the light fortnight and the Pitris in the dark fortnight.

sa: येषां न कश्चित् त्रसति न त्रसन्ति हि कस्यचित्। येषामात्मसमो लोको दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति ते॥
en: Those, of whom no creatures are afraid, and those, who are not afraid, of any creatures themselves, those, who regard all creatures as their own self, succeed in getting over all difficulties.

sa: अस्ति पौरवदायादो विदूरथसुतः प्रभो॥ ऋक्षैः संवर्धितो विप्र ऋक्षवत्यथ पर्वते।
en: There is another person of Puru's family, viz., Viduratha's son, O powerful one, who has been brought up among bears in the Rikshavat mountains.

sa: अम्बरीषं च नाभागं मृतं संजय शुश्रुम। य प्रजा वव्रिरे पुण्यं गोप्तारं नृपसत्तमम्॥
en: We hear, O Srinjaya, that Amvarisha also, the son of Nabhaga, met with death. That protector (of the world) and greatest of kings was considered by his subjects as the virtue incarnate.

sa: ततः स यज्ञं विव्याध रौद्रेण हृदि पत्रिणा। अपक्रान्तस्ततो यज्ञो मृगा भूत्वा सपावकः॥
en: Rudra then cut the embodiment of Sacrifice with a dreadful arrow in the heart. Assuming the shape of a deer, the embodied from of Sacrifice, fled away with the god of fire.

sa: उपासत द्विजाः पूर्वमर्थहेतोर्यमीश्वरम्। उपासते च तं ह्यद्य क्रव्यादा मांसहेतवः॥
en: The Brahmanas formerly used to wait upon this lord for money. Alas beasts of prey wait upon him to-day for feasting upon his body!

sa: श्रूयतां विस्तरो राम सगरस्य महात्मनः। शंकरश्वशुरो नाम्ना हिमवानिति विश्रुतः॥ विन्ध्यपर्वतमासाद्य निरीक्षेते परस्परम्। तयोर्मध्ये समभवद् यज्ञः स पुरुषोत्तम ॥
en: Do you, O Rāma, hearken to the story of the high-souled Sagara's sacrifice. Sankara's fatherin-law is the far-famed Himavat. And approaching each other, the Himavat and the vindhya behold each other. And on the region lying between them took place, O foremost of men, that sacrifice of Sagara's.

sa: एष लोकार्चितः साधुर्हिते नित्यं रतः सताम्। अस्मानधिगतानेष श्रेयसा योजयिष्यति॥
en: This pious one honoured of men, ever engaged in the welfare of the righteous, shall do good to us, who have come to him.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं महार्थं सा वानरी लक्ष्मणमप्रमेयम्। पुनः सखेदं मदविह्वलाक्षी भर्तुर्हितं वाक्यमिदं बभाषे॥
en: Having thus said Lakşmaņa of immeasurable intelligence words fraught with high import, that female monkey, her eyes drooping with languor, again sadly spoke in this wise for the behoof of her husband.

sa: आराधयिष्याम्यत्राहमगस्त्यं तं महामुनिम्। शेषं च वनवासस्य सौम्य वत्स्याम्यहं प्रभो।।८८।
en: I shall adore the mighty ascetic, Agastya, and, O mild one, O master, here pass away the remainder of the term of my banishment.

sa: किं ते व्याधिसमुत्थानं पक्षयोः पतनं कथम्। दण्डो वायं धृतः केन सर्वमाख्याहि पृच्छतः॥
en: Now, what ailment has attacked you? And why have your plumes fallen off? And who has dealt this punishment to you? Do you tell all this to me, who am asking you.

sa: ते वयं वनमत्युग्रं प्रविष्टाः पिदृशासनात्। द्रष्टुमिच्छामहे सर्वे भगवन्तं निवेद्यताम्॥
en: Having entered this horrid forest, in consonance with the mandate of our sire, we desire to see the reverend one. Tell this to him.

sa: दिष्ट्या रामश्चिरस्याद्य द्रष्टुं मां समुपागतः॥ मनसा काङ्कितं ह्यस्य मयाप्यागमनं प्रति। गम्यतां सत्कृतो रामः सभार्यः सहलक्ष्मणः॥
en: By luck it is that after a long time, Rāma has come to see me. I had mentally wished for his arrival. Go you; and let Rāma, having been respectfully received, come before me. Why have you not brought himself?

sa: तं शिष्यः प्रश्रितं वाक्यमगस्त्यवचनं ब्रुवन्॥ प्रावेशयद् यथान्यायं सत्काराहँ सुसत्कृतम्।
en: Then joyfully communicating to Rāma the words of the reverend one, the disciple (of Agastya) duly took in that one worthy of being honoured.

sa: धातूनामिव शैलेन्द्रो गुणानामाकारो महान्। तत् क्षमो न विरोधस्ते सह तेन महात्मना ॥ दुर्जयेनाप्रमेयेण रामेण रणकर्मसु।
en: Like to Himālaya, the king of mountains, containing diverse metals, he is the mine of various accomplishments. It does not behove you therefore to enter into conflict with that high-souled Răma, incomparable in prowess and hard to conquer in battle.

sa: राज्ञो दशरथस्य त्वमयोध्याधिपतेर्विभो॥ धर्मज्ञस्य वदान्यस्य महार्षिसमतेजसः। अस्य भार्यासु तिसृषु ह्रीश्रीकीर्युपमासु च॥ विष्णो पुत्रत्वमागच्छ कृत्वाऽऽत्मानं चतुर्विधम्। तत्र त्वं मानुषो भूत्वा प्रवृद्धं लोककण्टकम्॥ अवध्यं दैवतैर्विष्णो समरे जहि रावणम्। स हि देवान् सगन्धर्वान् सिद्धांश्च ऋषिसत्तमान् ॥
en: Do you, O lord, dividing yourself into four, O Vişņu, become born a sons in the three wives, resembling Modesty, Auspiciousness, and Fame, of Ayodhyā's lord, king Dasaratha, cognizant of Duty, and munificent, and possessing energy, and like to a Maharsi. Do you, O Visnu, becoming man, slay in battle this thorn of the worlds, the pampered Răvaņa, incapable of being slain by the gods; for the foolish Rākşasa by virtue of sublimated prowess, baffles the deities, and the Gandharvas, and the Siddhas, and the foremost of saints.

sa: गते रामे प्रशान्तात्मा रामो दाशरथिर्धनुः। वरुणायाप्रमेयाय ददौ हस्ते महायशाः॥
en: When Rāma had departed, Dasaratha's son the illustrious Rāma, of serene soul, made over the bow to the hands of Varuna of immeasurable strength.

sa: हन्तारं सर्वसैन्यस्य पौरुषे पर्यवस्थितम्। परिश्चान्तं महासत्त्वं मेने रामं खरस्तदा॥
en: At this time Khara thought that Destroyer of all his forces, established in his manliness, the exceedingly powerful Rāma to be overcome with fatigue.

sa: दानमानादिसत्कारैः कुरुष्व प्रत्यनन्तरम्। वैरमेतत् समुत्सृज्य तव पार्श्वे स तिष्ठतु॥
en: By conferring on him gifts and honours do you receive him back. And do you renounce your enmity and let him sit by you.

sa: अब्रवीज्जननीः सर्वा इह तस्य महात्मनः। शर्वरा शयिता भूमाविदमस्य विमर्दितम्॥
en: And he said to his mothers, That high-souled one lay down here on the ground during the night, and his limbs pressed this spot.

sa: चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि वत्स्यामि विजने वने। कन्दमूलफलैर्जीवन् हित्वा मुनिवदामिषम्॥
en: I shall live in the forest for fourteen years abstaining from animal food and living on tuberous roots and fruits like to the ascetics.

sa: ताः क्षीरं जातमात्रस्य कृत्वा समयमुत्तमम्। ददुः पुत्रोऽयमस्माकं सर्वासामिति निश्चिताः॥
en: 'Surely he shall be son to us all’-concluding thus, they as soon as he was born, by turns began to dispense milk to him.

sa: व्यसनी वा समृद्धो वा गतिरेष तवानघ। एष लोके सतां धर्मो यज्ज्येष्ठवशगो भवेत्॥
en: O sinless one, whether in prosperity or in adversity, even this one is your way. That a younger brother should follow his elder is in this world the duty of the righteous.

sa: कच्चित् सौम्य न ते राज्यं भ्रष्टं बालस्य शाश्वतम्। कच्चिच्छुश्रूषसे तात पितुः सत्यपराक्रम।७।।
en: O mild one, child that you are, your kingdom ever yours has not been wrested from you? And, O you having truth for prowess, do you, my child, minister to our sire?

sa: मदान्वितानां घोराणां कुञ्जराणां तरस्विनाम्॥ कथमेका महारण्ये न विभेषि वरानने।
en: Alone in this forest, are you not afraid of these terrible elephants of fierce motion and maddened with the exuding of their temporal juice?

sa: राज्याच्च हीनो भ्रात्रा च पक्षाभ्यां विक्रमेण च। सर्वथा मर्तुमेवेच्छन् पतिष्ये शिखराद् गिरेः॥
en: Deprived of my kingdom, and my brother, and my wings, and my prowess, I wishing to put a period to my existence, will hurl myself headlong from this summit of the mountain.

sa: तच्चापि जानामि तथाविषा बलं नरश्रेष्ठ शरीरजस्य। जानामि यस्मिंश्च जनेऽवबद्धं कामेन सुग्रीवमसक्तमद्य ॥
en: And, O foremost of men, I also know the irresistible force of Kāma. I know by whom Sugrīva has been taken captive, and that his heart is not now in the work.

sa: विक्रीडंश्च क्वचिद् भूमौ पुनरेव निषीदति। आश्रमद्वारमागम्य मृगयूथानि गच्छति॥ मृगयूथैरनुगतः पुनरेव निवर्तते। सीतादर्शनमाकाङ्क्षन् राक्षसो मृगतां गतः॥
en: Sometimes playing around, sometimes lying on earth and sometimes following the deer-herd having come within the thresh hold of the asylum and then followed again by them that Rākṣasa assuming the form of a deer came back to see Sītā.

sa: उपाधिर्न मया कार्यो वनवासे जुगुप्सितः। युक्तमुक्तं च कैकेय्या पित्रा मे सुकृतं कृतम्॥
en: Therefore I ought not to accept any substitute for living in the woods, who can but contribute to my censure. Kaikeyi has spoken what is proper; and my father has acted well.

sa: सुग्रीवश्चापि तत्सर्वं श्रुत्वा रामस्य वानरः॥ चकार सख्यं रामेण प्रीतश्चैवाग्निसाक्षिकम्।
en: Then the monkey Sugrīva, having heard all from Rāma was well pleased with Rāma, and in the presence of fire, made friends with him.

sa: शत्रुः पतिप्रवादेन मात्रेव हितकाम्यया। आशीविष इवाङ्गेन बाले परिधृतस्त्वया॥ यथा हि कुर्याच्छत्रुर्वा सर्पो वा प्रत्युपेक्षितः। राज्ञा दशरथेनाद्य सपुत्रा त्वं तथा कृता ॥
en: You O girl, in consideration of your welfare, have like to a mother taken to your lap a venomous snake in the form of your husband, Even what is done by an enemy or a serpent left alone, is being done by Dasaratha of wicked ways and false soothing speech, to you and your own son.

sa: या चान्या शैलदुहिता कन्याऽऽसीद् रघुनन्दन। उग्रं सुव्रतमास्थाय तपस्तेपे तपोधना॥
en: The other daughter of the mountain, O descendant of Raghu, adopting a stern vow, began to carry on austerities, having asceticism for her wealth.

sa: अथ कालोपमौ युद्धे सुतौ सुन्दोपसुन्दयोः॥ यज्ञविघ्नकरौ तौ ते नैव दास्यामि पुत्रकम्। मारीचश्च सुबाहुश्च वीर्यवन्तौ सुशिक्षितौ॥
en: The sons of Sunda and Upasunda resemble Kāla himself in battle, and it is they who are disturbing your sacrifice. Therefore I will not part with my son. And Mārīca and Subāhu are possessed of prowess, and accomplished in weapons.

sa: प्रकृत्या हिमकोशाढ्यो दूरसूर्यश्च साम्प्रतम्। यथार्थनामा सुव्यक्तं हिमवान् हिमवान् गिरिः॥
en: Naturally abounding in snow, and now having the sun at a great distance, the mountain Himavān+ justly bear that name. Himavan means having snow.-T

sa: तस्यायं कर्मणो देवि विपाकः समुपस्थितः। अपथ्यैः सह सम्भुक्ते व्याधिरनरसे यथा॥ तस्मान्मामागतं भद्रे तस्योदारस्य तद् वचः।
en: O exalted lady, even as a disease generated by one's taking rice with unhealthy curry, this danger is imminent in consequence of that act. O gentle one, the words of that noble-minded person are about to be verified in me.

sa: स नानाकुसुमैः कोर्णः कपिः साङ्करकोरकैः। शुशुभे मेघसंकाशः खद्योतैरिव पर्वतः॥
en: And strewn with various sprouts and buds and blossoms, the monkey resembling a mass of clouds, looked lovely like a bill filled with glowworms.

sa: निष्पन्दास्तरवः सर्वे निलीना मृगपक्षिणः। नैशेन तमसा व्याप्ता दिशश्च रघुनन्दन॥
en: The trees stand motionless, and the beasts and birds are silent, and, O descendant of Raghu, all sides have become enveloped in nocturnal gloom.

sa: गतोऽर्धरात्रः काकुत्स्थ कथाः कथयतो मम। निद्रामभ्येहि भद्रं ते मा भूद् विघ्नोऽध्वनीह नः॥
en: But, O Kākutstha, while I was speaking, half the night has been spent. Do you now sleep, good betide you, so that you may not feel any difficulty while on the journey.

sa: कृतोद्वाहे गते तस्मिन् ब्रह्मदत्ते च राघव। अपुत्रः पुत्रलाभाय पौत्रीमिष्टिमकल्पयत्॥
en: And, O Raghava, when Brahmadatta was married, that sonless one, (Kušanābha), with the intention of obtaining male offspring, took in hand a son-conferring sacrifice.

sa: अथ प्रतिसमादिष्टो लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा। प्रविवेश गुहां रम्यां किष्किन्धां रामशासनात्॥
en: Thereupon, Laksmana, the slayer of foes, commanded, entered, at the behest of Rāma, the pleasant city of Kişkindhā situated in the centre of caves.

sa: ततस्तयोरपाये तु शून्ये सीतां यथासुखम्। निराबाधो हनिष्यामि राहुश्चन्द्रप्रभामिव ॥
en: When they shall have departed, I shall carry off from the empty asylum, Sītã without let, like Rāhu depriving the Moon of his splendour.

sa: बुध्यता च मया वीर्यं रावणस्य दुरात्मनः॥ पुत्रः संतर्जितो वाग्भिर्न त्राता मैथिली कथम्।
en: And knowing the prowess of the impious Rāvana, I said in rage to my son, versed in speech,-'Hearing her lamentation, and knowing them bereft of Sītā, why didst you not deliver her?'

sa: न दोषेणावगन्तव्या कैकेयी भरत त्वया। रामप्रव्राजनं ह्येतत् सुखोदकं भविष्यति॥
en: O Bharata, you ought not to cast any blame on Kaikeyī. This banishment of the king (Rāma), shall be for the good (of all).

sa: तामेवमुक्त्वा जननी लक्ष्मणं पुनरब्रवीत्। वाक्यं वाक्यविदां श्रेष्ठः श्रेष्ठः सर्वधनुष्मताम्॥
en: Saying these words to his mother, that best of men versed in speech and best of archers, again spoke to Lakşmaņa all these words.

sa: अपृष्ट्वा बुद्धिसम्पन्नान् वृद्धानाचार्यसम्मतान्। सौम्य वानरचापल्यात् त्वं मां वक्तुमिहेच्छसि ॥
en: Why did you purpose to address me thus out of fickleness, consequent upon your monkeyhood not asking your wise elders recognized by the preceptors?

sa: दक्षिणस्यामपि दिशि स्थितं श्वेतमिवाम्बरम्। कैलासशिखरप्रख्यं नानाधातुविराजितम्॥
en: There appears on the south a beautiful white hill resembling the Kailasa filled with various metals.

sa: प्राप्स्यसे त्वं महाप्राज्ञ मैथिली जनकात्मजाम्। यथा विष्णुर्महाबाहुर्बलिं बद्ध्वा महीमिमाम्॥
en: Surely shall you come by Maithilī the daughter of Janaka like to the mighty armed Viş ņu obtaining this earth after having bound Vāli.

sa: तेन विभ्राजिता तत्र सा सभापि व्यरोचत॥ विमलग्रहनक्षत्रा शारदी द्यौरिवेन्दुना।
en: That entire assembly looked beautiful in his presence, like the cloudless, autumnal sky crested with stars and planets, in the presence of the moon.

sa: कृतार्थोऽस्मि महाबाहो कृतं गुरुवचस्त्वया। सिद्धाश्रममिदं सत्यं कृतं वीर महायशः। स हि रामं प्रशस्यैवं ताभ्यां संध्यामुपागमत्॥
en: O mighty-armed one, I have obtained my desire; and you have executed your preceptor's mandate. And, O illustrious hero, you have truly made this a Siddhāśrama. Having thus extolled Rāma, he took Rāma and Lakşmaņa, to perform his evening devotions.

sa: ततस्तस्यैव वचनादुपेत्य परितप्यतः। स मया सहसा बाण उद्धृतो ममतस्तदा॥
en: Then coming forward, I in accordance with the direction given by him as he lay in agony, suddenly extracted the arrow from his vitals.

sa: तं तस्मै चाभ्युद्यतं सम्यङ्मणिकाञ्चनभूषितम्॥ दिदेश राजा रुचिरं रामाय परमासनम्।
en: Then the king desired Rāma to seat him upon a seat prepared expressly for him, excellent, and flaming and garnished with gold and gems.

sa: क्यिोपचारे कुशलानवद्या। रामस्य तां मातरमेवमुक्त्वा देवी सुमित्रा विरराम रामा॥
en: Having thus addressed Rāma's mother and inspired her with hope in various words, the noble and pleasant and blameless Sumitrā, clever in speech, paused.

sa: ततः साध्विति तद्वाक्यं ब्राह्मणाः प्रत्यपूजयन्। वसिष्ठप्रमुखाः सर्वे पार्थिवस्य मुखेरितम्॥
en: Thereat, the Brāhmaṇas with Vasiştha at their head, exclaiming well! Well 1 approved the words that had fallen from the lips of the monarch.

sa: स त्वं धर्मपरो भूत्वा कश्यपाय वसुंधराम्। दत्त्वा वनमुपागम्य महेन्द्रकृतकेतनः॥
en: Embracing a life of righteousness, you did were confer the earth upon Kaśyapa and repaired to the forest, making the Mahendra hill your home.

sa: तरुप्रवालरक्ता सा नीलाङ्गं राक्षसेश्वरम्। प्रशोभयत् वैदेही गजं कक्ष्येव काञ्चनी॥
en: O hue like the light red of tender twigs, Vaidehi set off the dark-bodied lord of Rākşasas, as does a golden cover an elephant.

sa: प्रभाकराद्यैः सुस्निग्धैः प्रज्वलद्भिरिवोत्तमैः। वियुक्तां मणिभिर्जात्यैर्नवां मुक्ताबलीमिव॥
en: Like to a string of new pearls divorced from noble, mild-gleaming rubies and other excellent gems.

sa: निर्गच्छाश्वं महाभाग संगृह्य पुरुषर्षभ। यज्ञं पैतामहं वीर निवर्तयितुमर्हसि ॥
en: Do you, O highly pious one, go back, taking this horse, O foremost of men; and do you complete the sacrifice of your grand-father,

sa: ततः स गत्वा ताः पत्नीनरेन्द्रो हृदयंगमाः॥ उवाच दीक्षां विशत यक्ष्येऽहं सुतकारणात् ।
en: And coming there, that lord of men said to his favourite wives, Do you know it for certain that in order to obtain a son I am going to perform a sacrifice.

sa: राजपत्ल्यश्च गच्छन्त्यो मन्दं मन्दाकिनी प्रति। ददृशुस्तत्र तत् तीर्थं रामलक्ष्मणसेवितम्॥
en: And as the wives of the king were going slowly by the Mandākinī, they discovered the landing-place which was used by Rāma and Laksmana.

sa: शासनं श्रुत्वा सर्वमप्रतिकूलयन्। आरोप्य मैथिली पूर्वमारुरोहात्मवांस्ततः॥
en: Hearing his brother's command, that strongwilled one, furthering everything, having made Mithila's daughter ascend, ascended himself.

sa: भक्तां पतिव्रतां दीनां मां समां सुखदुःखयोः। नेतुमर्हसि काकुत्स्थ समानसुखदुःखिनीम्॥
en: O Kākutstha, who am poor in spirit, devoted to my husband, ever given to your service, and participating equally in your joy and sorrow.

sa: अप्रमेयं हि तत्तेजो यस्य सा जनकात्मजा। न त्वं समर्थस्तां हर्तुं रामचापाश्रयां वने॥
en: Incomparable is his power; daughter of Janaka is his wife and lives in the forest confiding in the mighty strength of his bow; you shall not be able to carry her away.

sa: स मुहूर्तं गते तस्मिन् देवलोकं मुनिस्तदा। जगाम तमसातीरं जाह्नव्यास्त्वविदूरतः॥
en: And when Nārada had left for the celestial regions, that holy person went to the banks of the Tamasā not very far from Jāhnavī.
