sa: कौसल्याया गृहं शीघ्रं राममातुर्नयन्तु माम्। नह्यन्यत्र ममाश्वासो हृदयस्य भविष्यति॥
en: Do you speedily take me to the room of Rāma's mother, Kausalyā; for in no other place shall I find rest for my heart.

sa: राजा च मन्त्रिसहितः सोपाध्यायः सबान्धवः॥ वाक्यं वाक्यविदां श्रेष्ठो वैदेहमिदमब्रवीत्।
en: And in company with his counsellors with his counsellors and priests and adherents, the king, foremost of those skilled in speech, spoke to Vaideha.

sa: ततोऽस्तुवन् मुनिगणा वसिष्ठं जपतां वरम्। अमोघं ते बलं ब्रह्मस्तेजो धारय तेजसा ॥
en: Then the ascetics in a body fell to eulogizing that best of mantra-reciting ones, Vasistha, saying, “Your might, O Brāhmaṇa, is infallible. Do you rein in the (Brahmā) energy, by your own.'

sa: यद्यस्य कृतमस्माभिर्बुध्यसे किंचिदप्रियम्। तद्बुद्ध्या सम्प्रधाशु क्षिप्रमेवाभिधीयताम्॥
en: Considering aright, did you speedily inform me if I have performed any improper act towards Rāma.

sa: विश्वामित्रोऽपितच्छ्रुत्वा ह्रिया किंचिदवाङ्मुखः॥ दुःखेन महताविष्ट समन्युरिदमब्रवीत्। तपश्च सुमहत् तप्तं राजर्षिरिति मां विदुः॥ देवाः सर्षिगणाः सर्वे नास्ति मन्ये तप:फलम्।
en: Hearing this, Viśvāmitra hanging down his head from shame and possessed by a mighty sorrow, said, in piteous accents, I have performed rigid austerities, yet the deities and the saints recognise me only as a Rājarși. I do not consider the fruit of my asceticism as gained.' on

sa: दीक्षितं व्रतसम्पन्नं वराजिनधरं शुचिम्। कुरङ्गशृङ्गपाणिं च पश्यन्ती त्वां भजाम्यहम्॥
en: I shall be ministering to you, seeing you initiated, engaged in ceremonies, wearing excellent deer skin for cloth and carrying horns in the hands.

sa: मृतायामपि वैदेह्यां नष्टायामपि राघव। शोचितुं नार्हसे वीर यथान्यः प्राकृतस्तथा॥
en: O descendant of Raghu, it become you not to lament like an ordinary person even if Janakí is dead or has been carried away.

sa: तद्वालिवचनाच्छान्तः कुर्वन् युक्तमतन्द्रितः। जग्राह सोऽभ्यनुज्ञातो मालां तां चैव काञ्चनीम्॥
en: Renouncing his inimical feelings, being thus addressed by Vāli and carrying out his words energetically Sugrīva accepted the golden garland as ordered (by him).

sa: कुतो निष्क्रमितुं शक्तिर्मया जीर्णस्य रक्षसः। भ्रातुस्तु मेषरूपस्य गतस्य यमसादनम्॥
en: 'Where is the power of coming out, of the Rākṣasa, your brother wearing the shape of a sheep, who has gone to Yama's abode?'

sa: खङ्गिनौ दृढधन्वानौ तिग्मतेजो महाभुजौ। भ्रातरौ विवशं प्राप्तौ कृष्यमाणौ महाबलौ॥
en: Those two highly powerful brothers, of mighty arms, with daggers and bows in their hands, were assailed and got hold of by that Raksasha.

sa: स हि देशो नरव्याघ्र प्रशस्तो यज्ञकर्मणि। तस्याश्वचर्या काकुत्स्थ दृढधन्वा महारथः॥ अंशुमानकरोत् तात सगरस्य मते स्थितः।
en: And that country, O best of men, is excellent as a sacrificial ground. And, O Kākutstha, equipped with a powerful bow, that mighty carwarrior, living under Sagara's sway, Ansumat, O child, followed the horse, for the purpose of protecting it.

sa: महत्सु तस्य शैलेषु पर्वतेषु गुहासु च। विचिन्वत महाभागां रामपत्नीमनिन्दिताम्॥
en: In those mighty mountains, as also in others and in their caves, do you search for that exalted lady, the blameless wife of Rāma.

sa: त्यक्त्वा वराण्यात्मविभूषितानि बर्हाणि तीरोपगता नदीनाम्। निर्भय॑माना इव सारसौषैः प्रयान्ति दीना विमना मयूराः॥
en: Leaving behind their excellent ornamentsthe tails, the peacocks, getting at the banks of the rivers, have been going away poorly and with depressed hearts as if being remonstrated with by the Sārasas.

sa: इदं हि तव विस्तीर्णं धनधान्यसमाचितम्। हस्त्यश्वरथसम्पूर्ण राज्यं निर्यातितं तया॥
en: This spacious kingdom abounding in corn and wealth, and filled with elephants, horses, and cars, is yours, having been conferred on you (by Kaikeyi).

sa: वसिष्ठपुत्रं तु सुयज्ञमार्य त्वमानयाशु प्रवरं द्विजानाम्। नभ्यर्च्य शिष्टानपरान् द्विजातीन्॥
en: Bring here speedily the worshipful Suyajña, the son of Vasiştha; want to repair to the forest after duly adoring him and other excellent Brahmanas.

sa: त्वत्कृतेन मया प्राप्तं रथचर्याकृतं सुखम्। आशंसे त्वत्कृतेनाहं वनवासकृतं सुखम्॥
en: I have through your favour experienced the pleasure of driving the car. I expect at your hands the pleasure of living in the woods.

sa: गवां शतसहस्रेण दीयतां शबला मम। रत्नं हि भगवनेतद् रत्नहारी च पार्थिवः॥ तस्मान्मे शबलां देहि ममैषा धर्मतो द्विज ।
en: Do you bestow on me Śabala for an hundred thousand kine. O worshipful one, verily this one is a jewel; and as it is the function of kings to acquire jewels, do you confer on me Śabala; for, O twice-born one, this one by right belongs to me.

sa: तस्य चन्द्रनिकाशेषु पर्वतेषु गुहासु च। रावणः सह वैदेह्या मार्गितव्यस्ततस्ततः॥
en: In the offshoots belonging to Kailasa resembling the moon, as also in their caverns, do you thoroughly search for Rāvaņa in company with Vaidehī.

sa: संत्यज्य सर्वकर्माणि मित्रार्थे यो न वर्तते। सम्भ्रमाद् विकृतोत्साहः सोऽनर्थेनावरुद्यते॥
en: He, who does not engage in the service of his friends renouncing all business, becometh void of all energy and involved in unnecessary troubles.

sa: स च सर्वैर्विचेतव्यः ससानुप्रस्थभूधरः। क्रौञ्चं गिरिमतिक्रम्य मैनाको नाम पर्वतः॥
en: are That also must be explored by you, that mountain with plains and plateous. Going beyond Krauncha, (you shall see) the mountain, named Maināka.

sa: सर्वमेतत् समालोक्य यच्चान्यदपि दृश्यते। गतिं विदित्वा वैदेह्याः संनिवर्तितुमर्हथ ॥
en: Having examined all these, as well others that may come within your ken, it behoves you, after having ascertained Vaidehi's course, to return (hither).

sa: स हि राजगुणैर्युक्तो युवराजः समीक्षितः। अपि चापि मया शिष्टैः कार्यं वो भर्तृशासनम्॥
en: Crowned with every regal virtue and selected as the heir-apparent (by the monarch), he is more meritorious by far than I am. I behove you to obey the order of your master.

sa: त्वरयस्व महाराजं यथा समुदितेऽहनि। पुष्य नक्षत्रयोगे च रामो राज्यमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: Do you urge expedition upon the mighty monarch, so that this day under the influence of the Puşya star Rāma may obtain the kingdom,

sa: ततो निक्षिप्तभारोऽहं राघवेण समागतः। निवेद्य गुरवे राज्यं भजिष्ये गुरुवर्तिताम्॥
en: On Rāghava coming (back), I shall, my burden being cast upon him, making over the kingdom to him, engage myself in serving my superior.

sa: उद्वहेयं भुजाभ्यां तु मेदिनीमम्बरे स्थितः। आपिबेयं समुद्रं च मृत्युं हन्यां रणे स्थितः॥
en: Stationing myself in the welkin I can with my hands raise up the earth. I can drink up the waters of the ocean. And engaged in conflict I can destroy Death itself

sa: ततो हलहलाशब्दो महान् समुदपद्यत। रथैरश्वैर्गजैश्चापि जनानामुपगच्छताम्॥
en: Then there arose a mighty hubbub occasioned by people coming up in cars, horses and elephants.

sa: न क्वचित् साधु मन्येत नेमं तथानुशोचामि जीवितक्षयमात्मनः॥ मातरं पितरं चोभावनुशोचामि मद्वधे। तदेतन्मिथुनं वृद्धं चिरकालभृतं मया॥ मयि पञ्चत्वमापन्ने कां वृत्तिं वर्तयिष्यति। वृद्धौ च मातापितरावहं चैकेषुणा हतः॥ केन स्म निहताः सर्वे सुबालेनाकृतात्मना।
en: This can never be reckoned as righteous even like to violating the chastity of a preceptor's wife. I do not so much lament my end as I lament it on account of my father and mother. To what will the old couple, who have ever been maintained by me, betake themselves when I am gone? My father and mother are old, and I their only son is slain. What boy is it of uncontrolled senses that has killed us all?

sa: अस्यामायत्तमस्माकं यत् कृत्यं रघुनन्दन । अहमेनं वधिष्यामि ग्रहीष्याम्यथवा मृगम्॥
en: It is our prime duty, O descendant of Raghu, to protect Jānaki. I shall either kill this deer or shall get hold of it.

sa: ततः पूर्वेण तो गत्वा त्रिकोशं भ्रातरौ तदा। क्रौञ्चारण्यमतिकम्य मतङ्गाश्रममन्तरे॥
en: Proceeding three Kośas towards the East and passing by the forest of Krauñca the two brothers descried on their way the asylum of Matanga.

sa: एतया तत्त्वया बुद्धया संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना। व्याहतेऽप्यभिषेके मे परितापो न पिद्यते॥
en: The mind being brought under discipline by this true rationale, there remains no cause of sorrow regarding my installation being put a stop to.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु वचनं रामो धर्मभृतां वरः। भूयस्तामब्रवीद् वाक्यं मातरं भृशदुःखिताम्॥
en: Rāma, the foremost amongst religious men, being spoken thus, said to his mother, who was greatly disturbed with sorrow, again in the following strain.

sa: स्थूलान् गिरिगुहाशय्यान् वानरान् वनचारिणः॥ सायाह्ने विचरन् राम दर्शयिष्यति लक्ष्मणः।
en: While roaming in the evening he shall point out to you fat monkeys ranging in the wood and lying in the hollows of mountains.

sa: इच्छाम्यनुगृहीतोऽहं त्वदर्थं परिवृद्धये। कार्यस्य न विमर्श च गन्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत॥ कर्ता चाहमशेषेण दैवतं हि भवान् मम। मम चायमनुप्राप्तो महानभ्युदयो द्विज। तवागमनजः कृत्स्नो धर्मश्चानुत्तमो द्विज ॥
en: I wish that I may be obliged by doing your will. And, ( you of excellent vows, you ought not to hesitate. I will every way accomplish your will; for you are my god. O regenerate one, surely great prosperity come to me in consequence of your coming, inasmuch as it shall be the means of bringing me entire and excellent merit, O Brāhmaṇa!

sa: कच्चित्ते कुशलं राजल्लङ्कायां राक्षसेश्वर। केनार्थेन पुनस्त्वं वै तूर्णमेव इहागतः॥
en: O lord of the Rākṣasas, O king, is it well with you in Lankā? And what for hast you again come hither so speedily?

sa: गृहे गृहे रुदत्यश्च भर्तारं गृहमागतम्। व्यगर्हयन्त दुःखार्ता वाग्भिस्तोत्रैरिव द्विपान्॥
en: And in every home females afflicted with woe, weeping child their husbands coming home, with the following words as (drivers) spur elephants with hooks.

sa: पूर्वमेव तु विग्राह्यः समवेक्ष्य नयानयौ। उत्पथं यः समारूढो नार्या राजा वशं गतः॥
en: The king bent upon following an unrighteous course through the influence of a woman, should, the justice or otherwise of the measure being fully weighed, at the very outset have been checked.

sa: रामं दाशरथिं रामो जामदग्न्यः प्रपूजितः। ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य जगामात्मगतिं प्रभुः॥
en: And that lord, Jamadagni's son Rama, having gone round Rāma, the son of Dasaratha, and honoured (by all), set out (for his own quarters).

sa: नियम्य कोपं परिपाल्यतां शरत् क्षमस्व मासांश्चतुरो मया सह। वसाचलेऽस्मिन् मृगराजसेविते संवर्तयशत्रुवधे समर्थः॥
en: Subduing your wrath, and awaiting the autumn, do you with me spend these four months in this hill filled with deer, capable as you are of encompassing the destruction of your enemy.

sa: आतिथ्यं कर्तुमिच्छामि बलस्यास्य महाबल। तव चैवाप्रमेयस्य यथार्ह सम्प्रतीच्छ मे॥
en: O highly powerful one, I desire to properly entertain you of immeasurable power, as well as your forces, do you, therefore, accept my hospitality.

sa: दुमशाखावभग्नोऽहं मुहूर्तं परिनिष्टनन्। सान्त्वयित्वा त्वनेनोक्तो न पुनः कर्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: Being struck by him with branches of trees, while I fled away and wept, he, consoling me, said only Do not do this again.

sa: गजश्च बलवान् वीरस्तिसृभिः कोटिभिर्वृतः। ऋक्षराजो महातेजा जाम्बरान्नाम नामतः।॥ कोटिभिर्दशभिर्व्याप्तः सुग्रीवस्य वशे स्थितः।
en: And the powerful and heroic Gaja (came), surrounded by three kotis. And the king of bears, Jāmbavān by name, (came), surrounded by ten koțis, and enlisted himself under the command of Sugriva.

sa: सत्क्रियां हि भवानेतां प्रतीच्छतु मया कृताम्। राजंस्त्वमतिथिश्रेष्ठः पूजनीयः प्रयत्नतः॥
en: Do you receive the hospitality which I extend to you. O king, you are the foremost of guests, and art worthy of assiduous homage.'

sa: रामलक्ष्मणयो राजन् गोदानं कारयस्व ह। पितृकार्यं च भद्रं ते ततो वैवाहिकं कुरु॥
en: do you now, O king, give away kine on behalf of the nuptials of Rāma and Lakşmaņa; and also perform their ancestral rites, good to you; and then complete the marriage ceremony.

sa: त्वं मयाऽऽत्मविनाशाय भवनं स्वं निवेशिता।९।। अविज्ञानानृपसुता व्याला तीक्ष्णविषा यथा।
en: It is to bring down destruction upon myself that through ignorance I brought to this house you like to a serpent of virulent poison.

sa: परेतकाले पुरुषो यत् कर्म प्रतिपद्यते। विनाशायात्मनोऽधयं प्रतिपन्नोऽसि कर्म तत्॥
en: Truly have you for your own destruction engaged yourself in these impious acts, which are perpetrated by men on the eve of their death.

sa: दीयमानां न तु तदा प्रतिजग्राह राघवः। अविज्ञाय पितुश्छन्दमयोध्याधिपतेः प्रभोः॥
en: And bestowed on Rāghava, I was accepted of him, after he had consulted the wish of his father, that lord, the master of Ayodhyā.

sa: दृष्ट्वा स नृपतिस्तत्र विश्वामित्रमथाब्रवीत्। अद्य यज्ञसमृद्धिर्मे सफला दैवतैः कृता॥
en: And then the monarch looking into Viśvāmitra's face, said, To-day by the grace of the gods, has my sacrifice been crowned with success, to-day.

sa: इत्येवमार्तस्य रघुप्रवीरः श्रुत्वा वचो वालिजघन्यजस्य। संजातवाष्पः परवीरहन्ता रामो मुहूर्तं विमना बभूव ॥
en: Hearing the words of Vali's younger brother, who was bewailing thus, Rāma, the heroic descendant of Rāghu and the slayer of foes, remained stupefied for some time with tears in his eyes.

sa: एवं ब्रुवाणं तमृषि तथेत्युक्त्वा स राघवः। सीतामालोक्य धर्मज्ञामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: When the saint had spoken thus, Rāghava saying, “So be it," turned his eyes to Sītā, and thus spoke to that one knowing morality.

sa: ऋषिवाटाश्च दृश्यन्ते शकटीशतसंकुलाः। देशो विधीयतां ब्रह्मन् यत्र वत्स्यामहे वयम्॥
en: And the abodes of ascetics are thronged with hundreds of cars. Do you, O Brahmana, arrange for some place were we may put up.

sa: राज्यकामो मम क्रोधो भरते यो बभूव ह। तं विराधे विमोक्ष्यामि वज्री व्रजमिवाचले॥
en: That ire of mine which I had conceived against Bharata hankering after the kingdom, will I discharge on Virādha; even as the wielder of the thunder-bolt hurls his weapon at a hi!l.

sa: दृष्ट्वा सुरपतिस्त्रस्तो विषण्णवदनोऽभवत्॥ अथ दृष्ट्वा सहस्राक्षं मुनिवेषधरं मुनिः। दुर्वृत्तं वृत्तसम्पन्नो रोषाद् वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: And seeing him, the countenance of the lord of the celestials turned pale. And seeing the wicked thousand-eyed deity in the guise of an ascetic, the well-behaved anchorite fired with rage said.

sa: तदिदं शाश्वतं पित्र्यं सर्वं सचिवमण्डलम्। पूजितं पुरुषव्याघ्र नातिक्रमितुमर्हसि ॥
en: Therefore, O chief of men, you ought not to pass by this honoured band of ancestral ministers, who have always been serving this race.

sa: गोध्ने चैव सुरापे च चौरे भग्नव्रते तथा। निष्कृतिर्विहिता सद्भिः कृतघ्ने नास्ति निष्कृतिः॥
en: Do you understand that, O monkey. The pious provide deliverance for the cow-killer, the winebiber, the thief, and the violator of vows; but for the ungrateful person there is no deliverance whatever.

sa: नैष वारयितुं शक्यस्त्वया क्रूरो निशाचरः। सत्त्ववाञ्जितकाशी च सायुधश्चैव दुर्मतिः॥
en: You will not be able to withstand this mighty, wicked and cruel night-ranger wearing emblems of conquest and having a scimitar in his hand!

sa: तं विनाशय भद्रं ते मा ते बुद्धिरतोऽन्यथा। प्राप्स्यसे महतीं कीर्ति शाश्वतीमव्ययां ध्रुवाम्॥
en: Kill him and be blessed. Let not your heart be led away to any other course. By killing him you will certainly achieve a great thing and also eternal and undying fame.

sa: ते कोटिशतसंख्येन कौन्तेयं महता तदा। अभ्यवर्षन् महात्मानं धनवर्षेण पाण्डवम्॥
en: They (the Mleccha kings) showered upon the illustrious son of Kunti, the Pandava (Bhima), every thick shower of wealth counted by hundreds of millions.

sa: नरराष्ट्रं च निर्जित्य कुन्तिभोजमुपाद्रवत्। प्रीतिपूर्वं च तस्याजौ प्रतिजग्राह शासनम्॥
en: Having then conquered the country, named Nararashtra, he marched against Kuntibhoja. He (the king of Kuntibhoja) very willingly accepted the sway (of the Pandavas).

sa: अवर्षं चातिवर्षं च व्याधिपावकमूर्च्छनम्। सवमेतत् तदा नासीद् धर्मनित्ये युधिष्ठिरे॥
en: During the reign of Yudhishthira, who was ever devote to virtue, there were no draughts, or floods, or plagues, or fires, or premature deaths.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः श्रुत्वैव भीष्मस्य चेदिराडुरुविक्रमः। युयुत्सुर्वासुदेवेन वासुदेवमुवाच हः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having heard these words of Bhishn:a, the greatly powerful Chedi King, being desirous of fighting with Vasudeva (Krishna), thus spoke to Vasudeva.

sa: नकुलः सुबलं राजन् सहपुत्रं समन्वयात्। द्रौपदेयाः ससौभद्राः पर्वतीयान् महारथान्॥
en: O king, Nakula followed Subala and his son, the sons of Draupadi and the son of Subhadra followed the great car-warrior, the mountain kings.

sa: तमुवाचैवमुक्तस्तु धर्मराजो जनार्दनम्। तव प्रसादाद् गोविन्द प्राप्तः क्रतुवरो मया॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having been thus addressed Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira) thus replied to Janardana (Krishna), "O Govinda, through your grace I have accomplished the great sacrifice.

sa: श्रियं तथाऽऽगतां दृष्ट्वा ज्वलन्तीमिव पाण्डवे। अमर्षवशमापन्नो दह्यामि न तथोचितः॥
en: Seeing the splendour of the Pandava's prosperity, and being afflicted with jealousy, I am as if on fire although I should not be jealous.

sa: खसा एकासना ह्यर्हाः प्रदरा दीर्घवेणवः। पारदाश्च कुलिन्दाश्च तङ्गणाः परतङ्गणाः॥
en: Namely (the kings) of the khasas, the Ekasanas, the Arhas, the Pradaras, the Dirghavenus, the Paradas, the Kulindas, the Tanganas, and the other Tanganas,

sa: त्रिंशद्दासीक एकैको यान् बिभर्ति युधिष्ठिरः। सुप्रीताः परितुष्टाश्च ते ह्याशंसन्त्यरिक्षयम्॥
en: Were all supported by Yudhishthira who presented each with thirty serving girls. They being thus gratified always pray for the destruction of his foe.

sa: क्षत्रियस्य महाराज जये वृत्तिः समाहिता। स वै धर्मस्त्वधर्मो वा स्ववृत्तौ का परीक्षणा॥
en: O great king, the character of a Kshatriya is to be known from (his) success. Whether sinful or virtuous, what scruples can there be in performing the duties of one's own (caste).

sa: अनर्थमर्थं मन्यसे राजपुत्र संग्रन्थनं कलहस्याति घोरम्। तद् वै प्रवृत्तं तु तथा कथंचित् सृजेदसीन् निशितान् सायकांच॥
en: O prince, you consider an act, which will bring in its train the fearful consequences of war and which is really fraught with mischief, as a great blessing. If it once begins, it will produce sharp swords and pointed arrows.

sa: जहर्ष कर्णोऽतिभृशं सह दुःशासनादिभिः। इतरेषां तु सभ्यानां नेत्रेभ्यः प्राप्तज्जलम्॥
en: Karna with Dushasana and others laughed aloud, but tears began to flow from the eyes of all those that were present in the assembly.

sa: भारद्वाजश्च सर्वेषामाचार्यः कृप एव च। कुत एतावपि प्रश्नं नाहतुर्द्विजसत्तमौ॥
en: The son of Bharadvaja (Drona), the preceptor of all of us and also Kripa, why these best of Brahmanas do not answer her question?

sa: अहं ज्यायानहं ज्यायानिति कन्येप्सया तदा। तयोर्देवनमत्रासीत् प्राणयोरिति नः श्रुतम्॥
en: We have heard that they wagered even their own lives saying “I am superior,” “I am superior,” for the sake of obtaining a bride,

sa: क्रुद्धस्य तस्य सर्वेभ्यः स्रोतोभ्यः पावकर्चिषः। वृक्षस्येव विनिश्चेरुः कोटरेभ्यः प्रदह्यतः॥
en: Like the fire that comes out of every crevice of a burning tree, sparkles of fire emitted from every part of angry Bhima's body.

sa: दुःशासन उवाच दुःखेनैतत् समानीतं स्थविरो नाशयत्यसौ। शत्रुसाद् गमयद् द्रव्यं तद् बुध्यध्वं महारथाः॥
en: Dushasana said O great car-warrior, the old man has thrown away, what we earned with so much trouble. Know that he had made over the whole of that wealth to our enemies.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अथाब्रवीन्महाराज धृतराष्ट्रं जनेश्वरम्। पुत्रहार्दाद् धर्मयुक्ता गान्धारी शोककर्षिता॥
en: Vaishampayana said O great king, it was then the virtuous Gandhari, afflicted with grief on account of her sons, addressed king Dhritarashtra and said.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो व्यध्वगतं पार्थं प्रातिकामी युधिष्ठिरम्। उवाच वचनाद् राज्ञो धृतराष्ट्रस्य धीमतः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thereupon at the command of the intelligent Dhritarashtra Pratikamin, thus spoke to the son of Pritha, king Yudhisthira who had gone (by this time) to a great distance from Hastinapur.

sa: अथ सभ्याः सभामध्ये समुच्छ्रितकरास्तदा। ऊचुरुद्विग्नमनसः संवेगात् सर्व एव हि॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thereupon those that were present in the Sabha raising up their arms, said in great anxiety of mind and in great emotion.

sa: सुयोधनमिमं पापं हन्तास्मि गदया युधि। शिरः पादेन चास्याहमधिष्ठास्यामि भूतले॥
en: I shall kill this sinful wretch Suyodhana (Duryodhana) in a club-fight. Felling him on the ground, I shall place my foot on his head.

sa: अर्जुनः प्रतिजानीते भीमस्य प्रियकाम्यया। कर्णं कर्णानुगांश्चैव रणे हन्तास्मि पत्रिभिः॥
en: For doing what is agreeable to Bhima, Arjuna vows that he will kill in battle with his arrows this Karna with all his followers.

sa: तां क्रोशन्तीं पृथा दुःखादनुवव्राज गच्छतीम्। अथापश्यत् सुतान् सर्वान् हृताभरणवाससः॥
en: As she went away weeping and lamenting, Pritha (Kunti) herself in grief, followed her. She saw her sons, shorn of their ornaments and robes.

sa: पाञ्चाली पाण्डवानेतान् दैवसृष्टोपसर्पति॥ तस्याः पार्थाः परिक्लेशं न ऑस्यन्ते घमर्षणाः।
en: Of celestial origin, Panchali is the wedded wife of the Pandavas. The wrathful sons of Pritha will never forgive the insult offered to her.

sa: एतदन्तास्तु भरता यद् वः कृष्णा सभां गता॥ यैषा पाञ्चालराजस्य सुता सा श्रीरनुत्तमा।
en: Vidura said This will prove the destruction of the Bharata race, namely the dragging of Krishna into the Sabha. This excellent daughter of the Panchala is Sree (the goddess of wealth) herself.

sa: बाहुप्रहरणेनैव भीमेन निहतो युधि॥ तस्य ते शम एवास्तु पाण्डवैर्भरतर्षभ।
en: Was killed in battle in Bhima with his bare arms. O best of the Bharata race, you should therefore make peace with the Pandavas.

sa: सोऽहं त्यक्तोधृतराष्ट्रेण राज्ञा प्रशासितुं त्वामुपयातो नरेन्द्र। तद् वै सर्वं यन्मयोक्तं सभायां तद्धार्यतां यत् प्रवक्ष्यामि भूयः॥
en: O ruler of men, having been (thus) abandoned by the king Dhritarashtra, I have come to you for giving you good counsel. What I said in the Sabha I shall now repeat to you. Hear and bear them in mind.

sa: यथाशनेर्विनिर्घोषो वज्रस्येव च पर्वते। तथा तयोः संनिपातः शरयोरभवत् तदा॥
en: The two arrows fell on him with a loud sound as that of lightning or as that of the thunder falling on a mountain.

sa: अथ पश्याम्यहं पार्थान् प्राप्तानिह कथंचन। पुनः शोषं गमिष्यामि निरम्बुर्निरवग्रहः॥
en: If ever I see the sons of Pritha (the Pandavas) returned to the city, I shall again be emaciated by abandoning food and drink.

sa: मैत्रेय उवाच तीर्थयात्रामनुकामन् प्राप्तोऽस्मि कुरुजाङ्गलान्। यदृच्छयाधर्मराजं दृष्टवान् काम्यके वने॥
en: Maitreya said : Setting out on a pilgrimage, I arrived at the Kurujangala. I suddenly met there Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira) in the forest of Kamyaka.

sa: मुञ्जवज्जर्जरीभूता बहवस्तत्र पादपाः॥ चीराणीव व्युदस्तानि रेजुस्तत्र महावने। तद् वृक्षयुद्धमभवन्मुहूर्तं भरतर्षभ। राक्षसानां च मुख्यस्य नराणामुत्तमस्य च॥
en: In that great forest innumerable trees, crushed like reeds, lay scattered like rags. O best of the Bharata race, that fight with trees between that foremost of Rakshasass (Kirmira) and that best of men (Bhima) lasted but for a moment.

sa: उक्तवांश्च महाबाहो क्वासौ वृष्णिकुलाधमः। वासुदेवः स मन्दात्मा वसुदेवसुतो गतः॥
en: O mighty armed hero, he (Shalva) said, "Where has that greatly vicious-minded son of Vasudeva, that disgrace of the Vrishni race Vasudeva (Krishna) gone?

sa: अनुरथ्यासु सर्वासु चत्वरेषु च कौरव। बलं बभूव राजेन्द्र प्रभूतगजवाजिमत्॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, O great king, all the streets of the city and its open spaces were filled with numerous horses and elephants.

sa: स रोषमदमत्तो वै कामगादवरुह्य च। प्रद्युम्नं योधयामास शाल्वः परपुरंजयः॥
en: Resolved to fight with Pradyumna and maddened with anger, that conqueror of hostile city, Shalva, then descended from his beautiful car of unchecked speed.

sa: ततः शाधिनुःश्रेष्ठं करात् प्रपतितं मम। मोहापन्नश्च कौन्तेय रथोपस्थ उपाविशम्॥
en: O son of Kunti, thereupon my Saranga bow fell from my hand; I fainted away and sat down on the side of the car.

sa: ततो ममासीन्मनसि मायेयमिति निश्चितम्। प्रबुद्धोऽस्मि ततो भूयः शतशोऽवाकिरं शरान्।॥
en: I then concluded in my mind that it was nothing but illusion. Thereupon regaining my senses, I again began to discharge hundreds of arrows.

sa: द्वादशेमानि वर्षाणि वस्तव्यं निर्जने वने। समाक्षध्य महारण्ये देश बहुमृगद्विमम्॥ बहुपुष्पफलं रम्यं शिवं पुण्यजनावृतम्। यत्रेमाः शरदः सर्वाः सुखं प्रतिवसेमहि॥
en: "We shall have to live in this lonely forest for twelve years; do you find out in this huge forest a spot, spot, charming, auspicious and abounding in many deer, birds, flowers and fruits and filled with pious men, where we may live happily for all these years."

sa: आयसं हृदयं नूनं तस्य दुष्कृतकर्मणः। यस्त्वांधर्मपरं श्रेष्ठं रूक्षाण्यश्रावयत् तदा॥
en: For, the heart of that one of impious deed is made of steel since he could address harsh words to his pious eldest brother.

sa: यदि सर्वमबुद्धीनामतिक्रान्तमचेतसाम्। अतिक्रमो मद्विधस्य कथंस्वित् स्यादनिन्दिते॥
en: Light-minded fools might transgress all these, but O faultless damsel, how can persons like myself (transgress).

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीमा गाथा नित्यं क्षमावताम्। गीताः क्षमावता कृष्णे काश्यपेन महात्मना॥
en: As an illustration of this, the following hymn, O Krishna, in honor of the forgiving has been sung by the high-souled and everforgiving Kashyapa.

sa: धातापि हि स्वकर्मैव तैस्तैर्हेतुभिरीश्वरः। विदधाति विभज्येह फलं पूर्वकृतं नृणाम्॥
en: And judging according to their pristine actions, the good and bad, the ordainer of the universe distributes among men, their portions in this world.

sa: यद्ध्ययं पुरुषः किंचित् कुरुते वै शुभाशुभम्। तद्धातृविहितं विद्धि पूर्वकर्मफलोदयम्॥
en: Know that whatever actions, either good or bad, that a person performs are the outcome of God's arrangements with reference to their pristine actions.

sa: यदेनः कुरुते किंचिद् राजा भूमिमवाप्नुवन्। सर्वं तन्नुदते पश्चाद् यज्ञैर्विपुलदक्षिणैः॥
en: Whatever sin a king commits in acquiring dominions, he consumes it all by means of performing sacrifices in which large Dakshinas are given away.

sa: तान्येकस्थानि सर्वाणि ततस्त्वं प्रतिपत्स्यसे। शक्रमेव प्रपद्यस्व स तेऽस्त्राणि प्रदास्यति॥ दीक्षितोऽद्यैव गच्छ त्वं द्रष्टुं देवं पुरंदरम्।
en: They are all collected together in one place. And he will (surely) give you all his weapons. Go to Shakra (Indra); he will give you all his weapons. Be initiated and go this very day to the god Purandara (Indra).

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा सर्वतो दृष्टिं चारयामास पाण्डवः। अथापश्यत् सव्यसाची वृक्षमूले तपस्विनम्॥
en: Having heard it, the Pandava (Arjuna) looked at all sides and Savyasachi (Arjuna) then saw an ascetic sitting at the foot of a tree.

sa: अहोऽयं कुसुमाराङ्गो हिमवच्छिखराश्रयः। गाण्डीवमुक्तान् नाराचान् प्रतिगृहणात्यविह्वलः॥
en: "Alas, this delicate bodied mountaincer of the Himalayas bear unmoved the arrows shot from the Gandiva.

sa: तदा वृक्षान् महाकायः प्रत्यगृहणादथो शिलाः। किरातरूपी भगवांस्ततः पार्थो महाबलः॥
en: Then the exalted deity in the disguise of the huge-bodied Kirata bore that shower of trees and stones too. The greatly strong Partha (Arjuna).

sa: अथास्त्रं जाज्वलद् घोरं पाण्डवस्यामितौजसः। मूर्तिमद् वै स्थितं पार्वे ददृशुर्देवदानवाः॥
en: The celestials and the Danavas saw that fearful weapon in its embodied from standing at the side of the immeasurably energetic and heroic Pandava.

sa: सहस्राक्षनियोगात् स पार्थः शक्रासनं गतः। अध्यक्रामदमेयात्मा द्वितीय इव वासवः॥
en: Seated on Shakra's seat, at the command of the thousand-eyed deity, the son of Pritha, of immeasurable prowess appeared like the second Vasava (Indra).

sa: येन पूर्वं महात्मानः खनमाना रसातलम्। दर्शनादेव निहताः सगरस्यात्मजा विभो॥
en: O exalted one, who destroyed by his glance alone the high-souled sons of Sagara when they came roaring towards him, that illustrious and invincible.

sa: एवमुक्तो महेन्द्रेण बीभत्सुरपि लोमशम्। उवाच प्रयतो वाक्यं रक्षेथाः पाण्डुनन्दनम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed by Mahendra, Vibhatsu also spoke to Lomasha with all reverence, saying, “Protect the son of Pandu (Yudhishthira).

sa: यदि वेदाः प्रमाणास्ते दिवसादूर्ध्वमच्युत। त्रयोदश समाः कालो ज्ञायतां परिनिष्ठितः॥
en: Therefore regard, O one of unfading glory, accepting the authority of the Vedas, the period of thirteen years equal to a day or so.

sa: द्यूतेन ते महाराज पुन तमवर्तत। भवांश्च पुनराहतो द्यूते नैवापनेष्यति॥
en: O great prince, the game of chance will once more begin. And then being again summoned at dice, we are sure to be banished.

sa: अन्तरेणापि कौन्तेय निकृति पापनिश्चयम्। हन्ता त्वमसि दुर्धर्ष सानुबन्धं सुयोधनम्॥
en: O son of Kunti, you shall without the help of deceit, which is doubtlessly a sin, slay that irrepressible Suyodhana with all his adherents."

sa: स निकृत्या जितो राजा पुष्करेणेति नः श्रुतम्। वनवासं सुदुःखार्तो भार्यया न्यवसत् सह॥
en: We have heard that the king was deceitfully defeated by Pushkara; and in consequence defeated by Pushkara; and in consequence thereof he dwelt in the forest with his spouse, pressed with distress.

sa: स्वं चैव रूपं कुर्वन्तु लोकपाला महेश्वराः। यथाहमभिजानीयां पुण्यश्लोकं नराधिपम्॥
en: It behoves the Lokapalas, the most excellent of the gods, therefore, to assume their respective forms, that I may ascertain that virtuous prince (Nala).

sa: निशम्य दमयन्त्यास्तत् करुणं प्रतिदेवितम्। निश्चयं परमं तथ्यमनुरागं च नैषधे॥ मनोविशुद्धिं बुद्धिं च भक्तिं रागं च नैषधे। यथोक्तं चक्रिरे देवाः सामर्थ्य लिङ्गधारणे॥
en: The celestials, having heard the words of Damayanti full of compassion and known for certain that her love for the prince of the Nishadhas was most fervent and also realizing her fixed will, purity of heart and mind and her passion for that prince, fulfilled what they had been prayed for by assuming their proper forms.

sa: तमब्रवीत् प्रहस्येन्द्रो निर्वृत्तः स स्वयंवरः। वृतस्तया नलो राजा पतिरस्मत्समीपतः॥
en: Indra smilingly said to him, “That Svayamvara is now over; king Nala has been accepted by her as her husband even in our presence.

sa: एवं तस्य तदा बुद्धिर्दमयन्त्यां न्यवर्तत। कलिना दुष्टभावेन दमयन्त्या विसर्जने।॥
en: Thus through the instrumentality of the wicked Kali, his mind then ceased to dwell on Damayanti and he settled his purpose of abandoning her.

sa: कस्य त्वं मृगशावाक्षि कथं चाभ्यागता वनम्। कथं चेदं महत् कृच्छ्रे प्राप्तवत्यसि भाविनि॥
en: 'O you having cyes like those of a young gazelle! whose are you! Why also have you entered into this forest? O handsome one! how have you fallen in this great predicament?'

sa: विस्तरेणाभिधास्यामि तन्मे शृणुत सर्वशः। विदर्भेषु महीपालो भीमो नाम महीपतिः॥
en: The ruler of the carth, Bhima by name, is the sovercign of the Vidharbhas, O foremost of twice-born ones! know me for his daughter.

sa: भर्तुरन्वेषणार्थं तु पश्येयं ब्राह्मणानहम्। यद्येवमिह वत्स्यामि त्वत्सकाशे न संशयः॥
en: 'I will find out those Brahmanas, who will search for my husband. Should you arrange all this, I shall no doubt live with you.'

sa: बृहदश्व उवाच एवं विमृश्य विविधैः कारणैर्लक्षणैश्च ताम्। उपागम्य ततो भैमी सुदेवो ब्राह्मणोऽब्रवीत्॥ अहं सुदेवो वैदर्भि भ्रातुस्ते दयितः सखा। भीमस्य वचनाद् राज्ञस्त्वामन्वेष्टुमिहागतः॥
en: Brihadashva said: Thereupon the Brahmana, Sudeva by name, having recognised the daughter of Bhima by observing the various circumstances and signs of hers, advanced to her and addressed her thus, O the daughter of Vidharbha! I am Sudeva, the intimate friend of your brother. Enjoined by king Bhima, I have come here searching for yourself. came

sa: नैषधं मृगयानेन दमयन्ति मया नलम्। अयोध्या नगरी गत्वा भाङ्गासुरिमुपस्थितः॥
en: “O Damayanti, searching Nala, the king of the Nishadhas, at last I went to the city of the Ayodhya and presented myself to Vangasuri.

sa: रश्मिभिश्च समुद्यम्य नलो यातुमियेष सः। सूतमारोप्य वार्ष्णेयं जवमास्थाय वै परम्॥ ते चोद्यमाना विधिवद् बाहुकेन हयोत्तमाः। समुत्पेतुरथाकाशं रथिनं मोहयन्निव॥
en: Nala, then raising the steeds by the reins and making Varshneya, the charioteer, sit on the car, commanded great speed and set out. Thereafter those foremost of horses, having been conducted by Bahuka according to the rules, rose to the sky and confounded the occupant of the car.

sa: ततस्तौ सहितौ रात्रिं कथयन्तौ पुरातनम्। वने विचरितं सर्वमूषतुर्मुदितौ नृप॥
en: O king, thercupon the happy pair passed the night at ease, relating to each other the past events of their wanderings in the forest.

sa: यदि त्वहमनुग्राह्यस्तवधर्मभृतां वर। संदेहं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि तन्मे त्वं छेत्तुमर्हसि॥
en: O foremost of all virtuous men, if I have deserved your favour, you will kindly dispel my doubts; I shall describe them to you.

sa: पुष्करेषु महाभाग देवाः सर्षिगणाः पुरा। सिद्धिं समभिसम्प्राप्ताः पुण्येन महतान्विताः॥
en: O greatly exalted one, is war formerly in Pushkara, that the celestials with the Rishis, having acquired great virtue, finally obtained the highest success.

sa: तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा शुचिः प्रयतमानसः॥ अग्निष्टोमातिरात्राभ्यां फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः।
en: If a man bathes in this Tirtha with subdued mind, he becomes pure. That man obtains the fruits of performing Agnishtoma and Atiratha sacrifices.

sa: तद् वनं प्रविशन्नेव सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते। ततश्चापि सरिच्छ्रेष्ठा नदीनामुत्तमा नदी॥ प्लक्षादेवी स्रता राजन् महापुण्या सरस्वती। तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वीत वल्मीकान्निःसृते जले॥
en: As soon as one enters that forest all sins are destroyed. There flows that best of streams, that foremost river of all rivers, that sacred goddess, O king, which is known (there) by the name of Plaksha Devi; bathing there in the water issuing forth from the bill.

sa: भद्रकर्णेश्वरं गत्वा देवमर्च्य यथाविधि। न दुर्गतिमवाप्नोति नाकपृष्ठे च पूज्यते॥
en: Going to Bhadrakarneshvara and worshipping the celestials according to proper rites, one never meets with any calamity; and becomes adored in the celestials region.

sa: तत्राक्षयवटो नाम त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतः। तत्र दत्तं पितृभ्यस्तु भवत्यक्षयमुच्यते॥
en: There is the Tirtha called Aksayavata, celebrated all over the three worlds. Whatever is offered there to the Pitris is said to become inexhaustible.

sa: कम्पनां तु समासाद्य नदी सिद्धनिषेविताम्। पुण्डरीकमवाप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: Then going to the river named Kampana frequented by the Siddhas one obtains the fruits of Pundarika sacrifice and goes to the celestials region.

sa: दिवौकसां पुष्करिणीं समासाद्य नराधिप। न दुर्गतिमवाप्नोति वाजिमेधं च विन्दति॥
en: O ruler of men, going to the tank, of the celestials, one never meets with any calamity; he obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sa: अथ सोमपदं गच्छेद् ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः। माहेश्वरपदे स्नात्वा वाजिमेधफलं लभेत्॥
en: Then one should go with concentrated mind and with Brahmacharya life to Somapada. Bathing in Maheshvara pada, one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sa: न वेदवचनात् तात न लोकवचनादपि। मतिरुत्क्रमणीया ते प्रयागमरणं प्रति॥
en: O child, let not the texts of the Veda or the opinions of men dissuade your mind from the desire of dying at Prayaga.

sa: न मत्कृते महीपाल पीडामभ्येतुमर्हसि। प्रयच्छ मामगस्त्याय वाह्यात्मानं मया पितः॥
en: "O ruler of earth, you should not grieve on my account. O father, bestow me on Agastya and save yourself by giving me away."

sa: इच्छामि त्वां स्रग्विणं च भूषणैश्च विभूषितम्। उपसर्तुं यथाकामं दिव्याभरणभूषिता॥
en: I desire that you should be adorned with garlands of flowers and I too should be adorned with those celestials ornaments that I like.

sa: स बाल एव तेजस्वी पितुस्तस्य निवेशने। इध्मानां भारमाजहे इध्मवाहस्ततोऽभवत्॥
en: Greatly powerful even in his childhood, he used to carry loads of sacrificial fuel to his father's house and hence he was called Idhmavaha.

sa: महिषैश्च वराहैश्च सृमरैश्चमरैरपि। तत्र तत्रानुचरितं शार्दूलभयवर्जितैः॥
en: Buffaloes, bears, deer and Chamaras (cows) wandered there at pleasure without having any fear of tigers.

sa: विष्णुना गोपितं शक्रं दृष्ट्वा देवगणास्ततः। सर्वे तेजः समादध्युस्तथा ब्रह्मर्षयोऽमलाः॥
en: Having seen Sakra (Indra) thus protected by Vishnu, all the celestials and the Brahmana Rishis of spotless deeds imparted to him their own might.

sa: दुर्गं समाश्रित्य महोमिमन्तं रत्नाकरं वरुणस्यालयं स्म॥
en: Then they made the ocean, with the mountain, like waves, the abode of Varuna, their fort.

sa: ते प्रविश्योदधिं घोरं नक्रग्राहसमाकुलम्। उत्सादनार्थं लोकानां रात्रौ घ्नन्ति ऋषीनिह॥
en: Having entered the fearful ocean full of sharks and crocodiles, they (now) kill the Rishis at night with the intention of exterminating all creatures.

sa: उवाच वचनं सर्वांस्तदा दैववशानृप। अनागमाय गच्छध्वं भूयो मार्गत वाजिनम्॥
en: O king, impelled by Destiny, he spoke to them thus, “Go away, never return. O sons, search again for the horse in all directions.

sa: अत्रैव रुद्रो राजेन्द्र पशुमादत्तवान् मखे। पशुमादाय राजेन्द्र भागोऽयमिति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: O king of kings, here at this spot Rudra seized the sacrificial beast. O king of kings, he then exclaimed, “This is my share.

sa: अव्याहतगतिश्चैव रथस्तस्य महात्मनः। रथेन तेन तु सदा वरदानेन वीर्यवान्॥
en: The car of that illustrious hero could go everywhere in an unobstructed course. Being greatly powerful by having received boons, he on that car.

sa: ततो देवाः समेत्याहुर्ऋषयश्च महाव्रताः। देवदेवं सुरारिनं विष्णुं सत्यपराक्रमम्॥ भगवन् भूतरक्षार्थमर्जुनं जहि वै प्रभो। विमानेन च दिव्येन हैहयाधिपतिः प्रभुः॥ शचीसहायं क्रीडन्तं धर्षयामास वासवम्। ततस्तु भगवान् देवः शक्रेण सहितस्तदा। कार्तवीर्यविनाशार्थ मन्त्रयामास भारत॥
en: Thereupon the celestials and the Rishis of great vows all met together; and they thus spoke to the god of gods, the slayer of Asuras, Vishnu of great prowess, “O lord, O exalted one, kill Arjuna to protect all creatures. The lord, the ruler of the Haihayas, on his celestials car, chastised Vasava (Indra) when he was sporting with Sachi. O descendant of Bharata, thereupon the exalted deity (Vishnu) held a consultation with Sakra (Indra) as how to kill Kartavirja.

sa: स तेन तीर्थेन तु सागरस्य पुनः प्रयातः सह सोदरीयैः। स्तीर्थं प्रभासं समुपाजगाम॥
en: He then with his brothers went along those Tirthas on the sea-coast; and he then came to Prabhasa, the fame of which had been spread by the Brahmanas all over the world.

sa: नासौ धिया सम्प्रति पश्यति स्म किं नाम कृत्वाहमचक्षुरेवम्। जातः पृथिव्यामिति पार्थिवेषु प्रवाज्य कौन्तेयमिति स्म राज्यात्॥
en: He does not now see with his minds eye how he has become so sightless and for what act he has grown blind among the kings of this entire earth. It is because he has banished the sons of Kunti.

sa: न विद्यते जाम्बवतीसुतस्य रणे विषां हि रणोत्कटस्य। एतेन बालेन हि शम्बरस्य दैत्यस्य सैन्यं सहसा प्रणुन्नम्॥
en: Nothing exists which can withstand the force of the son of Jambavati when he becomes irresistible in fight on the field of battle. The army of the Daitya Shamba was speedily routed (by him) when he was but a boy.

sa: च्यवन उवाच महोत्साहौ महात्मानौ रूपद्रविणवत्तरौ। यो चक्रतुर्मां मघवन् वृन्दारकमिवाजरम्॥ ऋते त्वां विबुधांश्चान्यान् कथं वै नार्हतः सवम्। अश्विनावपि देवेन्द्र देवौ विद्धि पुरंदर॥
en: Chyavana said: O Indra, these two are of great energy, they are high-souled, beautiful and handsome, they have made me eternally young like a celestials. Why should you and the other celestials have a right to the Soma juice and not they? O lord of the celestials, O Purandara, know that the Ashvins are also celestials.

sa: लोमश उवाच एतदेव यदा वाक्यामाप्रेडयति देवराट्। अनादृत्य ततः शक्रं ग्रहं जग्राह भार्गवः॥
en: Lomasha said : When these words were said by the king of the celestials, the son of Bhrigu (Chyavana) did not heed them; and he took up the offering of (the soma).

sa: जलां चोपजलां चैव यमुनामभितो नदीम्। उशीनरो वै यत्रेष्ट्वा वासवादत्यरिच्यत॥
en: (Behold) Jala and Upjala the rivers on both the sides of the Yamuna. Ushinara surpassed Vasava (Indra in greatness) by performing a sacrifice here.

sa: तस्य प्रसादो वै देवैः कृतो न त्वमरैः समः। नामयो विद्यते मर्यो निमित्तायुर्भविष्यति॥
en: But the celestials, though very much favourably disposed towards him, did not still make his son immortal like the celestials. They said that on no condition a mortal can be made immortal.

sa: लोमश उवाच भरद्वाजस्तु कौन्तेय कृत्वा स्वाध्यायमाछिकम्। समित्कलापमादाय प्रविवेश स्वमाश्रयम्॥
en: Lomasha said: O son of Kunti, having collected the sacrificial fuel and after performing the ritual duties of the day Bharadvaja entered his hermitage.

sa: एतद् द्रक्ष्यसि देवानामाक्रीडं चरणाङ्कितम्। अतिक्रान्तोऽसि कौन्तेय कालशैलं च पर्वतम्॥
en: O son of Kunti, as we have passed the Kaola mountains you will now see the play-grounds of the celestials, marked with their foot-prints.

sa: ततोऽश्मसहिताधाराः संवृण्वन्त्यः समन्ततः। प्रपेतुरनिशं तत्र शीघ्रवातसमीरिताः॥
en: Being helped by the swift wind, showers of rain incessantly poured and filled all sides round.

sa: न हि शक्नोमि त्वां द्रष्टुं दिवाकरमिवोदितम्। अप्रमेयमनाघृष्यं मैनाकमिव पर्वतम्॥
en: I am unable to look at you who look like the rising sun, who is immeasurable and irrepressible and who resemble the Mainaka mountain.

sa: ततः स राक्षसैर्वाचा प्रतिषिद्धः प्रतापवान्। मा मैवमिति सक्रोधैर्भर्त्सयद्भिः समन्ततः॥
en: Thereupon that powerful hero was forbidden by the Rakshasas, saying “Don't do it” and from all sides they began to abuse him in anger.

sa: स भीमसेने निष्क्रान्ते मृगयार्थमरिन्दम। घटोत्कचं सानुचरं दृष्ट्वा विप्रद्रुतं दिशः॥
en: When that chastiser of foes, Bhimasena, went out hunting and when he (Jatasura) saw that Ghatotkacha and his followers were scattered in all directions,

sa: एकैकशश्च तान् विप्रान् निवेद्य वृषपर्वणि। न्यासभूतान् यथाकालं बन्धूनिव सुसत्कृतान्॥
en: And at the proper time having introduced to Vrishaparva the Brahmana, whom he only honoured and who had remained in his charge as friends,

sa: फलैरमृतकल्पैस्तानाचितान् स्वादुभिस्तरून्। तथैव चम्पकाशोकान् केतकान् बकुलांस्तथा॥
en: Clustered with delicious fruits of ambrosial taste. And (besides these) they beheld Champakas, Ashokas, Aetakas, Aakulas,

sa: स केसरीव चोत्सिक्तः प्रभिन्न इव वारणः। व्यपेतभयसम्मोहः शैलमभ्यपतद् बली॥
en: And that mighty one proud as a lion and looking like a mad elephant, rushed towards that cliff tree from all fear and affliction.

sa: त्वद्वाहुबलवेगेन त्रासिताः सर्वराक्षसाः। हित्वा शैलं प्रपद्यन्तां भीमसेन दिशो दश।॥
en: (Therefore) O Bhimasena, let all the Rakshasas, terrified with the force of your mighty arms, fly towards the ten cardinal points, leaving this mountain.

sa: एतैश्चान्यैश्च बहुभिर्नानारूपधरैस्तथा। सर्वमासीज्जगद् व्याप्त तस्मिन्नस्त्रे विसर्मिते॥
en: These and numerous other (beings), wearing various shapes, filled the universe when the weapon was discharged.

sa: देही च देहं संत्यज्य मृग्यमाणः शुभाशुभैः। कधं संयुज्यते प्रेत्य इह वा द्विजसत्तम॥
en: O best of Brahmanas, how is it that the consequences of the good or evil acts of an embodied being follow him in this world or after his death in the next?

sa: अथाब्रवीद्धर्मराजं तु कृष्णो दशाहयोधाः कुकुरान्धकाश्चा स्तिष्ठन्तु यत्रेच्छसि तत्र राजन्॥
en: Krishna, then addressing the Dharmaraja, said “O king, let the Dasharha warrior, the Kukuras and the Andhakas, obeying your orders remain wherever you wish.

sa: व्यदृश्यत तथा युक्तो यथा स्यात् पञ्चविंशकः। तमागतमृषि वृद्ध बहुवर्षसहरिणम्॥
en: He looked like a youth of twenty five years old. When that wise saint who had seen many thousands of years made his appearance,

sa: सर्वे देवैः समायान्ति स्वच्छन्देन नभस्तलम्। ततश्च पुनरायान्ति सर्वे स्वच्छन्दचारिणः॥
en: They were all as good as the gods themselves, could soar to the heavens, come down again and range at pleasure wherever they liked.

sa: एवमस्त्विति ते सर्वे प्रतिपूज्य महामुनिम्। स्वदेशमगमन् हृष्टा राजानो भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharatas, (then) those kings, saying "be it so" and bowing down to that great sage returned cheerfully to their country.

sa: एकार्णवे जले घोरे विचरन् पार्थिवोत्तम। अपश्यन् सर्वभूतानि वैक्लव्यमगमं ततः॥
en: O foremost of kings, once thus roving over that one great ocean, my heart was filled with great affliction on not seeing any creature.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच वन्तःपुरे राजपुत्रं जघाना स सायकस्तिग्मतेजा विसृष्टः श्रुत्वा दलस्तत्र वाक्यं बभाषे॥
en: Markandeya said : O king, when Vamadeva had said this, the (arrows) killed the prince in the inner apartment. Hearing that he had been killed by his arrows, Dala spoke these words.

sa: अतिष्ठदेकपादेन कृशो धमनिसंततः। तस्मै ब्रह्मा ददौ प्रीतो वरं वव्रे स च प्रभुम्॥
en: He remained for a time, standing on one leg; and became lean as the skeleton. Much pleased Brahmana granted him a boon, which he asked of the Lord in the following way:

sa: नार्यः कालेन सम्भूय किमद्भुततरं ततः। संशयं परमं प्राप्य वेदनामतुलामपि॥
en: And to those women also who in due time are subject to great troubles and suffer extraordinary pains, what is more wonderful than these?

sa: नैव यज्ञक्रियाः काश्चिन्न श्राद्धं नोपवासकम्॥ या तु भर्तरि शुश्रूषा तया सवर्गं जयत्युता।
en: She needs no sacrifices, nor she is required to perform Shraddha or to observe abstinence. When the wife offers all her services to her husband. In fact, thereby he alone obtains heaven.

sa: अपध्याता च विप्रेण न्यपतद् धरणीतले। बलाकां पतितां दृष्ट्वा गतसत्त्वामचेतनाम्॥
en: Having been injured by the Brahmana, the crane fell down upon the ground; and as she fell, the Brahmana, seeing her insensible and lifeless,

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच धर्मव्याधस्तु निपुणं पुनरेव युधिष्ठिर। विप्रर्षभमुवाचेदं सर्वधर्मभृतां वर॥
en: Markandeya said : O Yudhishthira, that foremost of all virtuous men, that pious fowler, then skillfully thus again spoke to that best of Brahmanas.

sa: स्रोतसासकृदाक्षिप्तं ह्रियमाणं बलीयसा। न प्रियेयुर्न जीर्येयुः सर्वे स्युः सार्वकामिकाः॥ नाप्रियं प्रतिपश्येयुर्वशित्वं यदि वै भवेत्। उपर्युपरि लोकस्य सर्वो गन्तुं समीहते। यतते च यथाशक्ति न च तद् वर्तते तथा॥
en: Again and again tossed and overpowered by the powerful current of his own actions. If there were absolute freedom of action, then no creature would die and none would be subject to decay or await his evil doom. Every body would then attain the object of his desire. All persons try to excel their neighbours; they try to do it with the utmost of their power, but the result becomes the reverse.

sa: ब्रह्मचारी यतात्मा च सततं विपुलव्रतः। ब्राह्मणाः पूजयन्त्येनं पाकयज्ञेषु पावकम्॥
en: He is self-controlled, he is of great religious merit, he is a Brahmachari and he is worshipped by the Brahmanas at the Paka sacrifice.

sa: प्रशान्तेऽग्निर्महाभाग परिश्रान्तो गवां पतिः। असुरान् जनयन् घोरान् मांश्चैव पृथग्विधान्॥
en: The greatly exalted sun, when fatigued is known as the Prashanta (fire). He created the fearful Asura and various other creatures of the earth.

sa: तमापतन्तं महिषं दृष्ट्वा सेन्द्रा दिवौकसः। व्यद्रवन्त रणे भीता विकीर्णायुधकेतनाः॥
en: When Indra and the other dwellers of heaven saw that Mahisha was advancing to attack them, they fled leaving behind their arms and colours.

sa: तानि सर्वाणि वाक्यानि यच्चान्यत् परिदेवितम्। विचिन्त्य नाधिगच्छामि गमनायेतराय वा॥
en: Reflecting on those words and also on (their) lamentations, I cannot make up my mind as to whether I should or should not go.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच सरस्तदासाद्य तु पाण्डुपुत्रा जनं समुत्सृज्य विधाय वेशम्। वनानि रम्याण्यथ पर्वतांश्च नदीप्रदेशांश्च तदा विचेरुः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : When the Pandavas reached the lake, they chose a place to live in far from the habitations of men. They roamed through charming forests and delightful mountains and beautiful valleys through which ran many rivers and stream-lets.

sa: अहमष्यद्य निश्चित्य गमनायेतराय च। कल्यमेव गमिष्यामि समीपं पार्थिवस्य ह॥
en: I shall also today make up my mind whether I should go or not and then I shall see the king (my father) tomorrow.

sa: साऽपतन्मेदिनी दीप्ता भासयन्ती महाप्रभा। अथान्यद् धनुरादाय गौतमो रथिनां वरः॥
en: That dart ornamented with gold, dropped down to the ground. Thereupon, the son of Goutama, that best of speakers, taking up a fresh bow.

sa: श्रूयतां चाभिधास्यामि जनकेन यथा पुरा। आत्मव्यवस्थानकरा गीताः श्लोका महात्मना॥
en: Hear, I shall recite to you the slokas which were chanted by the high-souled Janaka of old on the subject of controlling the soul.

sa: स्तोष्यामि देवैर्ऋषिभिश्च जुष्टं शक्त्या गुहं नामभिरप्रमेयम्। षडाननं शक्तिधरं सुवीरं निबोध चैतानि कुरुप्रवी॥
en: O foremost of the Kurus, I shall now with devotion pray to that matchless, powerful, six faced and brave Guha who is worshipped by the celestials and the Rishis. Listen to them.

sa: कथितं ब्राह्मणमहाभाग्यं राजन्यमहाभाग्यमिदानी शुश्रूषामह इति तानुवाच मार्कण्डेयो महर्षिः श्रूयतामिति इदानीं राजन्यानां महाभाग्यमिति। कुरूणामन्यतमः सुहोत्रो राजा महर्षीनभिगम्य निवृत्य रथस्थमेव नमौशीनरं शिबिं ददर्शाभिमुखं तौ समेत्य परस्परेण यथावयः पूजां प्रयुज्य गुणसाम्येन परस्परेण तुल्यात्मानौ विदित्वान्योन्यस्य पन्थानं न ददतुस्तत्र नारदः प्रादुरासीत् किमिदं भवन्तौ परस्परस्य पन्थानमावृत्य तिष्ठत इति॥ नाम
en: "You have spoken to us about the greatness of the Brahmanas, we now desire to hear about the greatness of the royal order the Kshatriyas." To them replied the great Rishi Markandeya, "Hear now of the greatness of the royal order." A king of the Kuru dynasty named Suhotra went on a visit to the great Rishis and as he was returning he saw king Shivi, the son of Ushinara. As they met, they each saluted the other as best fitted to his age. Considering each equal to the other, they did not allow way to each other. At this time Narada came. (He said) why are, you standing here thus blocking each others way?

sa: तीर्थानि देवा विविशु विशन् भारतासुराः। तानधर्मकृतो दर्पः पूर्वमेव समाविशत्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, the celestials visited the Tirthas whereas the Asuras did not visit them. Those sinful ones were first filled with pride.

sa: ससागरः सगगन सशैलः सबलाहकः। सभूमिः साग्निपवनो लोकोऽयं केन निर्मित:॥
en: Indeed, by whom has this universe with its oceans, its sky, its mountains, its clouds, its lands, its fire, and its wind, been created.

sa: स मया बहुशो भग्नः प्रभञ्जन् वै प्रभञ्जनः। तस्मान्न बिभ्ये देवर्षे क्रुद्धादपि समीरणात्॥
en: Indeed, the Wind that breaks many things has himself been again and agair broken by me. Therefore, O celestial Rishi, I am not afraid of him even when he comes in fury.

sa: सिद्धा हि यद् यदिच्छन्ति कुर्वते तदनुग्रहात्। तस्मात्तपः समास्थाय कुरुष्वात्ममनोरथम्॥
en: Those that are crowned with ascetic success can by virtue of that success do whatever they like. Therefore practising asceticism, realise all your wishes.

sa: अहं च तत् करिष्यामि यथा कुन्तीसुतोऽर्जुनः। धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सैन्यानि धक्ष्यत्यग्निरिवेन्धनम्॥
en: On my part, I shall so act as Kunti's son Arjuna may be able to consume the troops of Dhritarashtra's son, like raging conflagration.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच रजोऽहं वः प्रवक्ष्यामि याथातथ्येन सत्तमाः। निबोधत महाभागा गुणवृत्तं च राजसम्॥
en: You best of beings, I shall now declare to you accurately what (the quality of) Darkness is. You highly blessed ones, do you understand what those qualities are that belong to Darkness.

sa: भ्रातृणां च प्रियं राजन् स चकार परंतपः। निश्चित्य मनसा वीरो दत्तभुक्तफलं धनम्॥
en: O king, that hero, that chastiser of foes was engaged in doing good to his brothers, concluding in his mind that giving and enjoying are the only (proper) uses of the wealth.

sa: जहि त्वं सदृशेष्वेव मानं दर्पं च मागध। मा गमः ससुतामात्य सबलश्च यमक्षयम्॥
en: O Magadha king, throw away your superiority and pride in the presence of those that are your equals. Do not go to the abode of Yama with your sons, ministers, and troops.

sa: वृत्त एष हृषि प्रौढो मृत्युरेष मनोभवः। क्रोधो नाम शरीरस्थो देहिनां प्रोच्यते बुधैः॥
en: This anger originates in the heart and becomes powerful there. This anger which lives in the bodies of men and is born in their minds, is described by the wise as Death.

sa: रामकृष्णप्रणीतानां वृष्णीनां सूतनन्दन। न शक्यः सहितुं वेगः सर्वैस्तैरपि संयुगे॥
en: O son of charioteer, my assembled forces are incapable of standing the push as given by the Vrishnis, when commanded by Rama and Krishna.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच किमर्थं भगवानग्निः खाण्डवं दग्धुमिच्छति। रक्ष्यमाणं महेन्द्रेण नानासत्त्वसमायुतम्॥
en: Janamejaya said : Why did the high-souled Agni desire to consume the forest of Khandava, abounding in various living creatures and protected by Indra?

sa: तं तथा मोहितं दृष्ट्वा सारथिर्जवनैर्हयैः। रणादपाहरत् तूर्णं शिक्षितो दारुकिस्तदा॥
en: Having seen him thus unconscious, his trained charioteer, the son of Daruka, carried him off the field with the help of his fleet steed.

sa: या दुस्त्यजा दुर्मतिभिर्या न जीर्यति जीर्यतः। योऽसौ प्राणान्तिको रोगस्तां तृष्णां त्यजतः सुखम्।।५५
en: He alone enjoys true happiness who can renounce that thirst which cannot be cast off by the misguided, which does not decay with decrepitude, and which is considered as a fatal disease.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा गौतमः प्रीतो मन:कान्तमनुत्तमम॥ मेध्यं सुरगृहप्रख्यं पुष्पितैः पादपैर्वृतम्।
en: Seeing that charming and peerless spot, filled with blossoming trees, sacred, and looking like the house of a very god, Gautama was highly pleased.

sa: रुद्र उवाच समा द्वादश राजेन्द्र ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः। सततं त्वाज्यधाराभिर्यदि तर्पयसेऽनलम्॥ कामं प्रार्थयसे यं त्वं मत्तः प्राप्स्यसि तं नृप।
en: Rudra said: O king of kings, if for full twelve years you can incessantly pour libations of ghee into the sacrificial fire, you yourself leading all the while the life of a Brahmachari. Then, o king, you can obtain me, for the purpose for which you ask me."

sa: जनमेजय उवाच कथं प्रयातो दाशार्हो महात्मा मधुसूदनः। कानि वा व्रजतस्तस्य निमित्तानि महौजसः॥
en: Jariamejaya said How did the great should scion of the Dasharha race, the slayer of Madhu, go on his journey; and what were the omens observed when that of great prowess journeying?

sa: स गृहीत्वा सुमनसो मन्त्रपूता जनाधिप। मोदकैः पायसेनाथ मांसैश्चोपाहरद् बलिम्॥
en: He took up many flowers and sanctified them with Mantras, O king. With Modakas and frumenty and meat, he made offerings to the deity.
